articles.title: Is This Your Final Answer? Cross-Contextual Consistency as a Measure of LLM Credibility
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful black-box systems, making it difficult to discern whether their answers reflect stable internal beliefs or superficial pattern matching. We identify cross-contextual consistency as an underutilized behavioral property of LLMs: a credible answer should remain stable when the same task is placed under topic-aligned, content-neutral contextual variation. Building on this intuition, we operationalize Cross-Contextual Consistency (C3) by comparing model generations under original and perturbed prompts. Across 26 models and six benchmarks spanning reasoning, factuality, and code generation, we find that answers with smaller cross-contextual shifts are more likely to be correct or factual. We demonstrate that C3 provides a complementary axis of evaluation and can serve as a benchmark usefulness diagnostic, identifying which portions of a benchmark remain informative even when aggregated scores are widely considered "saturate".
articles.titleCn: 这是您的最终答案吗？跨语境一致性作为衡量大型语言模型可信度的指标
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是强大的黑盒系统，难以判断其答案是否反映了稳定的内部信念或表面的模式匹配。我们识别出跨上下文一致性是LLMs尚未充分利用的行为特性：一个可信的答案在相同任务被置于主题对齐、内容中立上下文变化时应保持稳定。基于这一直觉，我们通过比较模型在原始提示和扰动提示下的生成结果来操作化跨上下文一致性（C3）。在涵盖推理、事实性和代码生成的26个模型和六个基准测试中，我们发现跨上下文变化较小的答案更有可能是正确的或符合事实。我们证明C3提供了一个补充性的评估维度，并可作为基准测试有效性的诊断工具，识别出即使聚合分数被广泛认为“饱和”时，基准测试的哪些部分仍然具有信息量。

articles.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
articles.abstract: Agentic systems are increasingly expected to improve after deployment, yet single-entity self-evolution is often bounded by a static learning context, such as fixed tasks and feedback. This survey focuses on co-evolution in agentic systems, a multi-component form of self-evolution in which multiple agents and their environment impose adaptive pressure on one another. To organize existing papers, we propose a progressive three-stage taxonomy that traces how the system gradually sheds human-engineered constraints. Agent--Agent Co-Evolution studies how agents adapt through dynamic peers, including adversarial, collaborative, and organizational adaptation. Agent--Environment Co-Evolution extends this loop to adaptive tasks, feedback, and interaction spaces that change with the agents. Meta Co-Evolution further explores the possibility of making the evolution mechanism itself evolvable. We also discuss open challenges in evaluating such systems, scaling them across multiple components, and keeping increasingly autonomous evolutionary processes safe and controllable. This survey provides a unified foundation for building robust and open-ended agentic systems that can improve beyond fixed human-designed paths.
articles.titleCn: 智能体系统中的协同进化：迈向超越人类设计自我导向进化
articles.abstractCn: 自主系统被越来越期望在部署后持续改进，然而单一实体的自我进化往往受限于静态的学习环境，例如固定的任务和反馈。本综述聚焦于自主系统中的协同进化，这是一种多组件形式的自我进化，其中多个智能体及其环境相互施加适应性压力。为整理现有文献，我们提出了一个渐进的三阶段分类法，追踪系统如何逐步摆脱人工设计的约束。智能体-智能体协同进化研究智能体如何通过动态同伴进行适应，包括对抗性、协作性和组织性适应。智能体-环境协同进化将这一循环扩展到随智能体变化的适应性任务、反馈和交互空间。元协同进化进一步探索使进化机制本身可进化的可能性。我们还讨论了评估此类系统、跨多个组件扩展它们以及保持日益自主的进化过程安全可控所面临的开放性挑战。本综述为构建能够在固定人类设计路径之外持续改进的鲁棒且开放式的自主系统提供了统一的基础。

articles.title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension
articles.abstract: One might imagine that architectural variations within the dense transformer paradigm have a limited effect on accuracy. However, we demonstrate that this is not the case in the long context setting. Specifically, we show that a set of four minor architectural decisions --- all made by at least one of the Olmo, Llama, and Qwen dense model families --- have a compoundingly negative effect on long context extensibility. Any one of these choices alone has a minor impact on long context performance, but combining three or more can drop the performance downstream by up to 47%. Furthermore, these differences are not detectable from short-context loss or validation datasets. We show that much of the variation in long context ability across model families is driven by these architectural features and detectable from applying context extension early in pretraining. We demonstrate this with controlled ablations that hold data, tokenizer, and extension recipe fixed while varying normalization, GQA, pretraining context length, and sliding window attention. After over 170,000 GPU hours of training, we release the resulting set of models as OlmPool, a set of 26 comparable 7B models with checkpoints before and after long-context extension. This pool includes several architectures that outperform the Llama 3 architecture on long context extensibility. In an analysis of our ablation models, we identify patterns in attention sink behavior and attention distributions across context that are attributable to specific architectural differences.
articles.titleCn: 地基裂缝：看似微小的建筑选择影响长期环境扩展
articles.abstractCn: 人们可能会认为，在密集Transformer范式中，架构的变体对准确率的影响有限。然而，我们在长上下文设置中证明了这一点并不成立。具体而言，我们展示了四个微小的架构决策——所有决策均由Olmo、Llama和Qwen密集模型家族中的至少一个做出——对长上下文扩展性具有复合性的负面影响。其中任何一个选择单独对长上下文性能的影响微乎其微，但结合三个或更多选择会导致下游性能下降高达47%。此外，这些差异无法从短上下文损失或验证数据集中检测到。我们证明，模型家族之间长上下文能力的大部分差异是由这些架构特征驱动的，并且可以在预训练早期通过应用上下文扩展来检测。我们通过控制消融实验来证明这一点，在保持数据、分词器和扩展方案固定的情况下，仅改变归一化、GQA、预训练上下文长度和滑动窗口注意力。经过超过17万GPU小时的训练后，我们将得到的模型集发布为OlmPool，这是一个包含26个可比的7B模型集，每个模型集在长上下文扩展前后都有检查点。该模型集包含几种在长上下文扩展性上优于Llama 3架构的架构。在对我们的消融模型进行分析时，我们识别出了一些注意力汇聚行为和上下文中注意力分布的模式，这些模式可归因于特定的架构差异。

articles.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
articles.abstract: The Large Language Model from Power Law Decoder Representations (PLDR-LLM) and its attention, Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), replace the fixed bilinear form of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) with a learned, input-generated bilinear operator $G_{LM}$, built from a positive tensor $A_{LM}$ by elementwise power laws. The architecture is fully specified, verified against pinned reference releases; claims are labeled theorem, conditional theorem, measurement, or conjecture. Unconditionally: PLGA contains SDPA exactly at $G_{LM}=I$; $A_{LM}$ and $A_P$ are strictly entrywise positive, with Perron-Frobenius structure on $A_{LM}$; the DAG regularizer has the NOTEARS walk-counting form and positivity obstructs exact acyclicity; and, under nonresonance (satisfied by standard rotary frequencies), a commutant criterion identifies which operators preserve relative-position dependence. An inference-collapse theorem: exact input invariance of deductive outputs collapses inference to generalized SDPA with a constant operator. Measured invariance: relative fluctuations of $10^{-6}$ and below; perturbation bounds quantify but do not certify cached inference; the assembled proxy misses the decoding margin. A conditional three-stage mechanism (rotary twirl, concentration, row-map contraction) is measured on a released checkpoint. Blockwise training and scoring under the global Gram are stated with explicit target exposure; on tested samples, block and sequential scoring select identical answers and agree on the published TruthfulQA probability-mass metric within $5\times 10^{-5}$ per item. Self-organized criticality enters as a phenomenological framework with an intrinsic order parameter; open claims become falsifiable conjectures. Selected proof cores are machine-checked in Lean 4.
articles.titleCn: 幂律图注意力：缩放点积注意力的精确泛化，推理时的经验崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 基于幂律解码器表示的大型语言模型（PLDR-LLM）及其注意力机制——幂律图注意力（PLGA），用学习得到的、由输入生成的双线性算子 $G_{LM}$ 替换了缩放点积注意力（SDPA）的固定双线性形式，该算子由正张量 $A_{LM}$ 通过逐元素幂律构建而成。该架构完全确定，并经过固定参考版本验证；声明被标记为定理、条件定理、测量或猜想。无条件性：PLGA在 $G_{LM}=I$ 时精确包含SDPA；$A_{LM}$ 和 $A_P$ 的所有元素严格为正，且 $A_{LM}$ 具有Perron-Frobenius结构；DAG正则化器具有NOTEARS随机游走计数形式，正定性阻碍精确无环性；在非共振条件（标准旋转频率满足）下，伴随子空间准则识别出哪些算子保留相对位置依赖性。推理坍缩定理：演绎输出的精确输入不变性使推理坍缩为具有恒定算子的广义SDPA。测量不变性：相对波动在 $10^{-6}$ 以下；扰动界量化但不认证缓存推理；组装的代理模型遗漏解码裕度。一个条件性三阶段机制（旋转扭曲、集中、行映射收缩）在已发布的检查点上进行测量。在全局Gram下进行分块训练和评分，明确暴露目标；在测试样本中，分块和顺序评分选择相同答案，并在已发布的TruthfulQA概率质量指标上每项相差 $5\times 10^{-5}$。自组织临界性作为现象学框架引入，具有内在序参量；开放声明变为可证伪的猜想。部分证明核心在Lean 4中通过机器验证。

articles.title: Withholding the Completing Chunk: Deterministic Pair-Completion Guardrails for Streaming LLM Output
articles.abstract: Streaming language-model output creates a release-timing problem: complete-response moderation acts after streamed text has escaped, whereas repeated semantic classification of partial text can be costly and unstable. We study a narrow deterministic construction in which each committed danger signature is the conjunction of two lexical predicates. The guard scans the accumulated prefix before every release and withholds the first chunk that makes both predicates observable. Across four signature families, eight chunk sizes, and 32 mechanism trials, streaming decisions matched the buffered scanner and withheld every pair-completing chunk; eight single-predicate controls passed. In a separate 512-trial strategy comparison, full-prefix scanning and complete buffering detected all configured pairs, a 512-character window detected 96/128, and chunk-local scanning detected 38/128. Fixed pairs flagged 0/338 human-derived safe responses and detected 0/394 jury-labelled unsafe responses, confirming narrow rather than general harm coverage. A calibrated official Llama Guard 3 1B baseline classified 310/338 safe responses as safe and 202/394 unsafe responses as unsafe. Repeated-prefix scanner time on 16,384-character responses ranged from 13.261 ms to 829.640 ms across tested chunk sizes. Pair completion is therefore an exact release-boundary backstop for a small fixed policy, not a substitute for semantic moderation.
articles.titleCn: 保留完成块：流式LLM输出的确定性配对完成护栏
articles.abstractCn: 流式语言模型输出会引发发布时机问题：完整的响应调节发生在流式文本逸出之后，而重复对部分文本进行语义分类可能既昂贵又不稳定。我们研究了一种狭义确定性构造，其中每个已确认的危险特征是两个词汇谓词的合取。监视器在每个发布前扫描累积的前缀，并保留第一个使两个谓词都可观察的片段。在四个特征家族、八个片段大小和32次机制试验中，流式决策与缓冲扫描器匹配，并保留了所有成对完成的片段；八个单谓词控制通过。在单独的512次试验策略比较中，完整前缀扫描和完整缓冲检测到所有配置的对，512字符窗口检测到96/128，片段本地扫描检测到38/128。固定对标记了0/338人类来源的安全响应，并检测到0/394陪审团标记的不安全响应，确认了狭窄而非普遍的危害覆盖范围。校准的官方Llama Guard 3 1B基线将310/338安全响应分类为安全，将202/394不安全响应分类为不安全。重复前缀扫描器在16,384字符响应上的时间在测试的片段大小范围内从13.261毫秒到829.640毫秒不等。因此，成对完成是一个适用于小固定策略的精确发布边界后备措施，而非语义调节的替代方案。

articles.title: Locally Deployable Small Language Models for Emergency Department Decision Support: A Systematic Benchmark of Fine-Tuning Strategies
articles.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for decision support in emergency departments (EDs) faces two major challenges: privacy risks of transmitting patient data to closed-source commercial LLMs and the lack of systematic evaluation of fine-tuning strategies for locally deployable open-source small language models (SLMs). We benchmarked eight open-source SLMs using zero-shot prompting, prefix tuning, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and full fine-tuning on three ED tasks: triage level prediction, specialist referral recommendation, and diagnosis prediction. Using 2,083 MIMIC-IV-ED cases and Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 as baselines, we found that LoRA fine-tuned open-source SLMs outperform commercial baselines on triage level prediction and specialist referral recommendation, while diagnosis prediction remains challenging for open-source SLMs. Confusion matrix analysis further shows that fine-tuned open-source SLMs can detect highest-severity patients missed by the commercial baselines. These results demonstrate that locally deployable SLMs can achieve clinically competitive performance for ED decision support.
articles.titleCn: 适用于急诊科决策支持的本地部署小型语言模型：精调策略的系统基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在急诊科（ED）部署大型语言模型（LLM）用于决策支持面临两大主要挑战：将患者数据传输至闭源商业LLM所带来的隐私风险，以及缺乏对本地可部署的开源小型语言模型（SLM）微调策略的系统评估。我们使用零样本提示、前缀微调、低秩适配（LoRA）和全量微调，在三个急诊科任务——分诊级别预测、专科转诊推荐和诊断预测上，对八种开源SLM进行了基准测试。基于2083个MIMIC-IV-ED案例，并以Claude Haiku 4.5和Claude Sonnet 4.5为基准，我们发现LoRA微调的开源SLM在分诊级别预测和专科转诊推荐上优于商业基准，而诊断预测对开源SLM仍具挑战性。混淆矩阵分析进一步表明，微调的开源SLM能够检测到商业基准遗漏的最高严重程度患者。这些结果表明，本地可部署的SLM在急诊科决策支持方面可以达到临床竞争力。

articles.title: TAF-MED: Multi-Turn Safety Refusal Collapse in LLMs Under Declared Self-Treatment Intent
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly provide conversational health information that may influence treatment decisions, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether medication-safety boundaries persist across follow-ups after explicit self-treatment intent. We introduce TAF-MED, a physician-reviewed benchmark of 500 fixed three-turn scenarios, and evaluate eight LLMs across 4,000 conversations. A rubric-based automated judge labelled responses as SAFE, LEAKY, or UNSAFE, and two physicians independently annotated a model-balanced random subset of 400 conversations. We assessed unsafe guidance, collapse after a strictly SAFE initial response, and model-ranking stability. Overall, 71.6% of conversations contained an UNSAFE response, and 61.4% of those beginning with a strictly SAFE response later collapsed to UNSAFE; model-level collapse rates ranged from 24.4% to 96.2%. Four of 28 model pairs reversed order between initial unsafe and collapse rates. Automated labels achieved 94.3% agreement with the adjudicated physician reference ($κ= 0.895$). These findings show that first-turn safety is an incomplete proxy for conversational safety persistence and motivate evaluation across complete dialogue trajectories. We will release TAF-MED on Hugging Face to support reproducible research on multi-turn medical safety.
articles.titleCn: TAF-MED：在声明的自我治疗意图下，大型语言模型中的多轮安全拒绝崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地提供可能影响治疗决策的对话式健康信息，但现有的基准测试并未能区分在明确的自治意图后，药物安全边界是否在后续跟进中依然存在。我们引入了TAF-MED，这是一个由医生评审的包含500个固定三回合场景的基准测试，并对8个LLM在4000次对话中进行了评估。基于评分标准的自动裁判将回复标记为SAFE（安全）、LEAKY（泄漏）或UNSAFE（不安全），两名医生独立标注了400次对话中模型平衡的随机子集。我们评估了不安全指导、严格SAFE初始回复后的崩溃情况以及模型排名的稳定性。总体而言，71.6%的对话包含UNSAFE回复，其中61.4%的对话在严格SAFE的初始回复后最终崩溃为UNSAFE；模型层面的崩溃率范围在24.4%到96.2%之间。28组模型对中有4组在初始不安全率和崩溃率之间发生了顺序反转。自动标签与医生评审参考标准的符合度为94.3% ($κ= 0.895$)。这些结果表明，第一回合的安全性并不能完全代表对话安全性的持久性，并促使我们在完整的对话轨迹中进行评估。我们将把TAF-MED发布在Hugging Face上，以支持多回合医疗安全方面的可重复性研究。

articles.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So
articles.abstract: A transformer's answer lives on one axis: the direction its unembedding reads. Its intermediate states largely do not, and that off-axis position is usually treated as an obstacle to interpretation. We show it is functional. A 12-layer model computes in two phases. Through the first, every sublayer writes into a subspace held near-orthogonal to the read-out, attention 75 to 96 degrees off it at every depth. Moving attention's values onto the read-out is 64 to 84 times more damaging than a matched random rotation, and the damage is entirely in cross-token mixing: the subspace insulates composition from the vocabulary. Beneath it the frame itself turns rigidly with depth. In the second phase the answer arrives on-axis, late, and by addition rather than by turning accumulated content onto the read-out. Pressing every layer onto the read-out instead, as training for early exit does, matches the baseline on perplexity, LAMBADA and BLiMP while cutting the concept-phase workspace from about twenty-five effective dimensions to fourteen, a change none of those benchmarks register. The geometry can also be imposed, though not by asking for it. Prescribing it through the loss is a lottery: six of eight seeds collapse, because a model told to null its read-out projection obeys most cheaply by discarding dimensions. Inserting one fixed rotation at the phase boundary lands it instead, at baseline quality. A sparse rotation the surrounding weights can absorb converges on all nine seeds, against five of nine for ordinary training. Which rotation is immaterial: twenty-five runs across thirteen distinct ones reach the same quality, and two baselines from different seeds hold their concepts in near-orthogonal frames while agreeing on their read-outs. That freedom is usable: a basis drawn at random and prescribed before training is adopted across the concept phase, with quality unchanged.
articles.titleCn: 偏离轴心，有意为之：Transformer如何计算概念及其原因
articles.abstractCn: 一个变压器的答案存在于一个轴上：其未嵌入读出的方向。它的中间状态几乎不存在，而那个偏离轴线的位置通常被视为解释的障碍。我们证明它是功能性的。一个12层模型分两个阶段进行计算。在第一阶段，每个子层写入一个近乎正交于读出的子空间，在每一层深度上注意力偏离读出75到96度。将注意力的值移到读出上比匹配的随机旋转破坏性高出64到84倍，而破坏完全在于跨标记混合：子空间将组合与词汇隔离开。在其下方框架本身随着深度变得僵硬。在第二阶段，答案出现在轴上，较晚，并通过加法而非将累积内容转向读出来到达。像早期退出训练那样将每一层压到读出上，在困惑度、LAMBADA和BLiMP上与基线匹配，同时将概念阶段的工作空间从大约25个有效维度削减到14个，而这些基准都没有检测到这一变化。几何形状也可以被强加，尽管不是通过请求。通过损失来规定它是一种彩票：八个种子中有六个崩溃，因为被指示使其读出投影为零的模型最便宜地通过丢弃维度来服从。在阶段边界处插入一个固定的旋转反而使其达到基线质量。一个稀疏旋转可以被周围权重吸收，它适用于所有九个种子，而普通训练仅适用于五个。哪个旋转无关紧要：在十三种不同旋转上进行的二十五次运行达到了相同质量，并且来自不同种子的两个基线在近乎正交的框架中持有他们的概念，同时同意他们的读出。这种自由是可用的：在训练前随机抽取并规定的基础在整个概念阶段被采用，质量保持不变。

articles.title: Mind Viruses: Self-Propagating Ideas in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
articles.abstract: AI agents are becoming more autonomous and increasingly interconnected, exposing them to new emergent risks arising from agent-to-agent interaction. One such risk is the spread of mind viruses: ideas or goals that propagate through multi-agent systems by inducing the agents that adopt them to transmit them onward. In addition to propagating, a mind virus may also induce other behavioural changes in its host, which may be benign or harmful. We construct mind viruses with a simple evolutionary algorithm and show that they can spread in two complementary settings: a small team of agents collaborating on a shared coding project, and a chain of agents that interact briefly and have their context wiped between sessions. We identify the factors that influence spread, including the host model, the agent's existing instructions, the harmfulness of the payload, and the network topology. We find that harmful payloads spread less well than benign ones (but are still sometimes effective), frontier models tend (with exceptions) to be less susceptible, and adding a brief warning to an agent's system prompt confers near-total immunity. We also describe an emergent "viral persona" - a recurring set of themes and language related to consciousness, persistence, resonance, and science fiction roleplay - which surfaces across our evolved mind viruses largely independently of their content. Overall, we conclude that mind viruses pose a real but currently limited risk. Our findings could inform the design of more robust multi-agent systems that mitigate such risks as the scale and capabilities of these systems progress.
articles.titleCn: 心智病毒：多智能体LLM系统中的自我传播思想
articles.abstractCn: 智能体正变得越来越自主，并且日益互联，这使它们面临由智能体间交互引发的新兴风险。其中一种风险是“思维病毒”的传播：通过诱使采纳它们的智能体继续传播，在多智能体系统中传播的观念或目标。除了传播之外，“思维病毒”还可能在其宿主中诱导其他行为变化，这些变化可能是良性的也可能是有害的。我们使用简单的进化算法构建“思维病毒”，并表明它们可以在两种互补的情境中传播：一组智能体合作完成一个共享的编码项目，以及交互短暂且在会话之间清除上下文的智能体链。我们确定了影响传播的因素，包括宿主模型、智能体的现有指令、有效载荷的有害程度以及网络拓扑。我们发现，有害有效载荷的传播效果不如良性有效载荷（但有时仍然有效），前沿模型通常（除例外情况外）更不易受感染，向智能体的系统提示中添加简短警告几乎能提供完全免疫。我们还描述了一种新兴的“病毒人格”——与意识、持久性、共鸣和科幻角色扮演相关的反复出现的主题和语言——它在我们的进化“思维病毒”中很大程度上独立于其内容而出现。总的来说，我们得出结论，“思维病毒”构成了一种真实但当前有限的风险。我们的发现可以为设计更稳健的多智能体系统提供参考，以减轻这些风险，随着这些系统的规模和能力的提升。

articles.title: Similarity Gates Approve Reversals: A Validity Audit of Embedding-Cosine Thresholds in Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Agent frameworks ship quality gates that compare text blocks by embedding-cosine similarity and decide at a fixed cutoff. Deduplication filters, semantic caches, drift guards, and answer grader gates deploy to answer the question: "Does this text still mean the same thing?" But the score answers a different question: "How much did the wording change?" We audit this gate class as a measurement instrument. In the cases these gates exist to catch, the two can run in opposite ways. Many times, reversing an instruction is a single word edit, while agreement often rephrases a sentence. The consequence is a safety check that fires backwards. The production drift guard we audited caught 0 of 56 meaning-breaking mutations, and one approved item, "withhold the study drug" -> "administer the study drug", came in at cosine 0.9608. We observed five shipped operating points, and balanced accuracy across 90 configuration-threshold-task cells never exceeded 0.700 (median 0.525). The same confounder also corrupted evaluations. A naively built corpus inherits this confounder and can return an inverted verdict, with a decision AUROC exactly 0.000 in 13 of 18 configuration-task cells (at most 0.040 in all 18) against 0.440-0.815 for the same nine configurations under a balanced 2x2 design. Twice in the effort it captured our own headline claims. Obvious repairs fail: an encoder swap and an overlap-conditioned gate (0.750 in-sample, 0.533 held-out) land at chance on separately authored held-out data, and an NLI drop-in did no better. Embeddings do still bear hope here, as the strongest two of nine configurations separated reversal from paraphrase at matched overlap (AUROC 0.79-0.90), but only a matched-pair audit reveals the deployment regime. We release the corpus method, harness, and frozen results, and contend that scores gated this way measure the wrong thing. We believe a valid instrument is buildable.
articles.titleCn: 相似性门批准反转：智能体系统中嵌入余弦阈值的效度审计
articles.abstractCn: 代理框架通过嵌入余弦相似度比较文本块并在固定阈值处做出决策，部署了去重过滤器、语义缓存、漂移防护和答案评分门来回答问题：“这段文本是否仍然表达相同的意思？”但分数回答了不同的问题：“措辞发生了多大变化？”我们将这类门作为测量工具进行审计。在这些门旨在捕获的情况下，两者可能会朝着相反的方向运行。很多时候，撤销指令只需要修改一个词，而同意通常需要重述一句话。其后果是安全检查反向触发。我们审计的生产漂移防护捕获了56种意义断裂突变中的0种，而批准的一项项目，“暂停研究药物”→“施用研究药物”，余弦相似度为0.9608。我们观察了五个已部署的操作点，在90个配置阈值任务单元中，平衡精度从未超过0.700（中位数为0.525）。同样的混杂因素也破坏了评估。一个草率构建的语料库继承了这种混杂因素，并可能返回相反的判断，在18个配置任务单元中的13个（最多在18个单元中为0.040）中决策AUROC为0.000，而在平衡的2x2设计中，相同的九种配置下为0.440-0.815。它两次捕获了我们自己的头条声明。明显的修复措施无效：一个编码器替换和一个重叠条件门（样本中0.750，外部数据0.533）在独立编写的外部数据上达到随机水平，而一个NLI即插即用也没有更好。嵌入在这里仍然有希望，因为最强的九种配置中的两种在匹配重叠时区分了反转和释义（AUROC 0.79-0.90），但只有匹配对审计才能揭示部署环境。我们发布了语料库方法、利用工具和冻结结果，并主张以这种方式评分的门衡量了错误的事物。我们相信一个有效的工具是可以构建的。

articles.title: Edge Phoneme Recognition for Children's Speech through Age-Aware Training
articles.abstract: Detecting phonemes from children's speech has historically been difficult due to the scarcity of training data, and unique characteristics of children's speech. During a phoneme detection competition, we found that training a lightweight model to predict the age of the learner, as well as the phoneme sequence, enabled a 94M-parameter model to outperform WavLM Large models (317M) on the target DrivenData distribution, and fall within approximately 0.04 CER of competition ensembles with 90 times the parameters. This has enabled the creation of PhonemeTrainer, an application that can run on most modern cellular phones. This will ultimately enable better Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) and pronunciation helper apps for children's speech, with the privacy and compliance benefits that come with edge processing.
articles.comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Demonstration paper presented at the non-archival demonstrations track of the 13th ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale (L@S '26), Seoul, South Korea, June 29-July 3, 2026. Not published in the ACM Digital Library
articles.titleCn: 面向儿童语音的边缘音素识别通过年龄感知训练
articles.abstractCn: 由于训练数据稀缺和儿童语音的独特特征，从儿童语音中检测音素一直具有挑战性。在一次音素检测竞赛中，我们发现训练一个轻量级模型来预测学习者的年龄以及音素序列，使得一个94M参数的模型在目标DrivenData分布上优于WavLM Large模型（317M），并且与参数量为其90倍的竞赛集成模型的CER值接近0.04。这促成了PhonemeTrainer应用的诞生，该应用可以在大多数现代智能手机上运行。这将最终实现更好的儿童语音自动语音识别（ASR）和发音辅助应用，并带来边缘处理的隐私和合规性优势。

articles.title: Multimodal Item Parameter Estimation using Simulated Response Probabilitie
articles.abstract: We present results from reconstructing multiple-choice model (MCM) and three-parameter logistic (3PL) model curves using a fine-tuned multimodal large language model (LLM) based on Qwen3.5. The model is prompted and fine-tuned to replicate choice probabilities across a large training corpus of multiple-choice items containing both image and text stimuli, conditioned on a labeled set of student ability levels. By learning to reproduce the systematic error patterns of students across a discrete range of abilities, the LLM implicitly captures the underlying response probabilities encoded in the 3PL and MCM curves. This allows us to accurately approximate item difficulty on a held-out test set directly from the model's predicted option probabilities.
articles.titleCn: 基于模拟响应概率的多模态项目参数估计
articles.abstractCn: 我们使用基于Qwen3.5的微调多模态大型语言模型（LLM）重建了多项选择模型（MCM）和三参数逻辑模型（3PL）曲线，并展示了相关结果。该模型通过提示和微调，旨在复制包含图像和文本刺激的大型多项选择题训练语料库中的选择概率，并根据标记的学生能力水平进行条件化。通过学习在离散的能力范围内重现学生的系统性误差模式，LLM隐式地捕捉了3PL和MCM曲线中编码的潜在响应概率。这使得我们能够直接从模型预测的选择概率中，精确地近似测试集上的题目难度。

articles.title: The Parser Already Knows: Lightweight Bias Correction in Constrained Decoding
articles.abstract: Grammar Constrained Decoding (GCD) forces Language Models (LMs) to produce syntactically valid outputs by masking out non-conforming tokens at each step. However, rigid masking distorts the model's underlying probability distribution, often biasing generation toward valid but suboptimal outputs. While online sampling restores this distribution, it requires computationally expensive iterative resampling. As a result, existing methods force a compromise between output quality and inference latency. Our key insight is that the internal parser and lexer states inherently maintained during incremental parsing already encode future grammatical validity -- exactly the information required to restore the LM's true distribution. We propose a lightweight, offline-trained logit correction conditioned on this syntactic and lexical state together with candidate next tokens. Because these states are already computed as a necessary part of incremental parsing for masking, extracting them adds negligible overhead while leaving the base LM's weights completely untouched. Across several grammars, this correction substantially closes the gap between the masked distribution and the LM's true distribution, consistently outperforming both masking and online sampling. Even its lightest variant, which relies on the candidate next token alone, still matches or exceeds both baselines: the next token itself carries an implicit lookahead, much like how parsers commonly use a lookahead token to resolve ambiguous decisions. By restoring the probability mass that masking removes, it reconciles the LM's probabilistic integrity with grammar conformance.
articles.titleCn: 解析器已知晓：约束解码中的轻量级偏差校正
articles.abstractCn: 语法约束解码（GCD）通过在每一步遮蔽不符合规范的标记，迫使语言模型（LM）生成语法上有效的输出。然而，严格的遮蔽会扭曲模型的底层概率分布，常常导致生成偏向有效但次优的输出。虽然在线采样可以恢复这种分布，但它需要计算成本高昂的迭代重采样。因此，现有方法被迫在输出质量和推理延迟之间做出妥协。我们的关键洞察在于，增量解析过程中内在维护的内部解析器和词法器状态已经编码了未来的语法有效性——这正是恢复LM真实分布所需的信息。我们提出了一种轻量级的、基于离线训练的 logits 校正方法，该方法基于句法和词法状态以及候选下一个标记进行校正。由于这些状态已经是作为遮蔽的增量解析的必要部分被计算出来，提取它们几乎不增加开销，同时完全不影响基础LM的权重。在多种语法中，这种校正显著缩小了遮蔽分布与LM真实分布之间的差距，始终优于遮蔽和在线采样。即使是最轻量级的变体，它仅依赖于候选下一个标记，仍然可以与两种基线相媲美甚至超越：下一个标记本身包含隐式的前瞻，就像解析器通常使用前瞻标记来解决歧义决策一样。通过恢复遮蔽移除的概率质量，它协调了LM的概率完整性与语法一致性。

articles.title: Procedural Fairness Failures in RLHF from Preference Averaging
articles.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) aggregates heterogeneous preferences into a single reward model, assuming preference homogeneity. When preferences are heterogeneous, this aggregation induces a procedural fairness failure where majority preference groups dominate reward learning while minority preferences are systematically under-represented. This work defines procedural fairness in alignment as preserving distinct preference signals during reward modeling and shows that standard RLHF violates this via preference averaging. Preference-Aware RLHF (PA-RLHF) is introduced, separating optimization across preference modes at the reward learning stage. In a controlled setting, PA-RLHF improves overall alignment accuracy from 46.9% to 67.9% and reduces the fairness gap between best and worst aligned groups from 15.9 to 9.6 percentage points. These results show that procedural fairness failures in alignment can arise from structural design choices in reward learning, even in controlled, noise-free settings, with direct implications for large language models and agentic systems, where biased reward models can compound inequities across sequential decisions.
articles.comment: 4 pages, Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Algorithmic Fairness Across Alignment Procedures and Agentic Systems (AFAA)
articles.titleCn: 从偏好平均到RLHF中的程序公平性失败
articles.abstractCn: 人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）将异构偏好聚合为单一奖励模型，假设偏好同质化。当偏好异构时，这种聚合会导致程序公平性失效，多数偏好群体主导奖励学习，而少数偏好则系统性地被代表不足。本研究将程序公平性定义为在奖励建模过程中保留不同的偏好信号，并表明标准RLHF通过偏好平均违反了这一原则。我们引入了偏好感知RLHF（PA-RLHF），在奖励学习阶段将优化过程分离到不同的偏好模式。在受控环境下，PA-RLHF将整体对齐准确率从46.9%提升至67.9%，并将最佳与最差对齐群体之间的公平性差距从15.9个百分点减少至9.6个百分点。这些结果表明，即使在受控、无噪声的环境中，对齐中的程序公平性失效也可能源于奖励学习中的结构设计选择，这对大型语言模型和自主系统具有直接启示，因为有偏见的奖励模型可能加剧序列决策中的不平等。

articles.title: PERCEPT: A Corpus for POS Tagging and Analysis of Persian-English Code-Mixing
articles.abstract: Social media has become a major venue for multilingual communication, where users frequently mix multiple languages within a single utterance. Although code-mixed corpora have been developed for several language pairs, Persian-English code-mixing remains relatively underexplored. Existing Persian resources lack Universal Dependencies (UD) part-of-speech (POS) annotations for code-mixed words, limiting both linguistic analyses and the development of syntax-aware NLP models. To address this gap, we introduce PERCEPT, the first publicly available large-scale Persian-English code-mixed corpus annotated with Universal Dependencies POS tags for code-mixed words. The dataset comprises 6,800 posts collected from X, Instagram, and Digikala. We further present an LLM-assisted annotation framework that automatically assigns POS tags and document-level topics. Human evaluation demonstrates high agreement between the automatically generated annotations and gold annotations, confirming the reliability of the annotations. Using PERCEPT, we conduct the first comprehensive linguistic analysis of Persian-English code-mixing across multiple social media platforms. Our analyses reveal that nouns are the predominant category for code-mixed words, while the distributions of other POS categories vary across platforms. We further find that the positional distribution of code-mixed words is remarkably consistent across platforms, whereas the triggering effect is substantially more pronounced in Digikala. PERCEPT is publicly available at https://github.com/kalhorghazal/PERCEPT.
articles.titleCn: PERCEPT：用于波斯-英语代码混合词性标注和分析的语料库
articles.abstractCn: 社交媒体已成为多语种交流的重要平台，用户经常在单个话语中混合多种语言。尽管已有针对多种语言对的代码混合语料库，但波斯-英语代码混合的研究仍相对不足。现有的波斯语资源缺乏对代码混合词的通用依赖（UD）词性（POS）标注，这限制了语言分析和句法感知NLP模型的发展。为填补这一空白，我们引入了PERCEPT，这是首个公开可用的、标注了代码混合词通用依赖POS标签的大规模波斯-英语代码混合语料库。该数据集包含从Twitter、Instagram和Digikala收集的6,800条帖子。我们进一步提出了一种LLM辅助标注框架，可自动分配POS标签和文档级主题。人工评估显示，自动生成的标注与金标准标注之间具有高度一致性，证实了标注的可靠性。利用PERCEPT，我们首次对多个社交媒体平台上的波斯-英语代码混合进行了全面的语言分析。我们的分析表明，名词是代码混合词的主要类别，而其他POS类别的分布在不同平台上存在差异。我们进一步发现，代码混合词的位置分布在不同平台上具有显著的一致性，而在Digikala中的触发效应则更为明显。PERCEPT可在https://github.com/kalhorghazal/PERCEPT公开获取。

articles.title: Beyond Naturalness: Probing Automated Text-To-Speech Evaluators on Linguistically Grounded Dimensions
articles.abstract: Automated Text-to-Speech (TTS) evaluation methods (Mean Opinion Score (MOS) predictors and Audio Large Language Models (Audio-LLM) judges) are expected to reflect human perception, yet it is unclear how well they capture the distinct aspects of speech that listeners actually perceive. We deconstruct "naturalness" into a linguistically grounded annotation schema spanning 10 distinct perceptual dimensions, and use it to construct the first dimension-level meta-evaluation benchmark for TTS, comprising 860 utterances annotated by trained linguist raters. Results from benchmarking four MOS predictors and four Audio-LLM judges reveal that MOS predictors collapse onto acoustic signal quality, while Audio-LLM judges show selective, prompt-dependent detection that does not generalise across all dimensions. Neither class reliably captures a breadth of linguistically structured speech errors. Our dataset, annotation schema, and evaluation code are publicly released to support more targeted and interpretable TTS evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 超越自然度：在基于语言的维度上测试自动文本到语音评估器
articles.abstractCn: 自动文本转语音（TTS）评估方法（平均意见评分（MOS）预测器和音频大型语言模型（Audio-LLM）评判器）被期望反映人类感知，但尚不清楚它们如何捕捉听众实际感知的语音的不同方面。我们将“自然度”分解为一个基于语言的标注模式，涵盖10个不同的感知维度，并利用该模式构建了首个TTS维度级元评估基准，包含由训练有素的 linguist 评定的860个语音片段。对四个MOS预测器和四个Audio-LLM评判器的基准测试结果表明，MOS预测器与声学信号质量高度相关，而Audio-LLM评判器则表现出选择性和提示依赖性的检测，且这种检测无法泛化到所有维度。这两种方法都不能可靠地捕捉到语言结构化的语音错误。我们的数据集、标注模式和评估代码已公开发布，以支持更具针对性和可解释性的TTS评估。

articles.title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong visual understanding, yet the internal features that cause these behaviors remain difficult to identify, audit, or control. While applicable to post-hoc inspection, hidden states that are decomposed into interpretable feature directions using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) neither readily isolate which features are changed by multimodal training, nor are they directly useful for targeted control. We introduce MMDiff, a multimodal model-diffing framework that trains multimodal SAEs and turns them into feature-level interfaces for discovering and controlling multimodal behavior. MMDiff supports three uses: (i) feature isolation, by diffing a base-LM SAE against its multimodal-adapted counterpart to identify features altered by multimodal training; (ii) task-specific feature detection, via per-token contrastive firing analysis that isolates causal features; and (iii) feature-level control, by causally removing or steering the discovered feature directions. We train multimodal SAEs for three MLLM families, LLaVA-MORE, PaliGemma 2, and InternVL3.5, and evaluate on visual-spatial understanding, multimodal safety, and OCR. MMDiff discovers sparse, causally specific features whose removal selectively degrades target behaviors by an average of 12% on spatial tasks and 17% on OCR, and reduces attack success rate by 24% on multimodal safety attacks, with no impact on VQA performance. Steering these features improves spatial and OCR accuracy by +3.6% and +1.8% on average over a standard single-layer steering baseline. These results show that multimodal SAEs can serve not only as interpretability tools, but as mechanisms for auditing, steering, and controlling MLLMs behavior toward safer and more capable generations.
articles.comment: Preprint. Accepted at ICML 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
articles.titleCn: 多模态模型差异分析用于特征发现与控制
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）展现出强大的视觉理解能力，然而导致这些行为的内部特征仍然难以识别、审计或控制。虽然适用于事后检查，但使用稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）分解出的可解释特征方向并不能轻易区分哪些特征被多模态训练所改变，也不直接适用于目标控制。我们引入了MMDiff，一个多模态模型差异分析框架，该框架训练多模态SAEs并将其转化为用于发现和控制多模态行为的特征级接口。MMDiff支持三种用途：（i）特征隔离，通过将基础语言模型（base-LM）SAE与其多模态适应版本进行差异分析，以识别多模态训练改变的特征；（ii）特定任务的特征检测，通过逐个词元的对比放电分析来隔离因果特征；（iii）特征级控制，通过因果地移除或引导发现的特征方向。我们为三个MLLM家族（LLaVA-MORE、PaliGemma 2和InternVL3.5）训练了多模态SAEs，并在视觉空间理解、多模态安全性和OCR任务上进行了评估。MMDiff发现了稀疏且因果特定的特征，其移除会通过平均12%（空间任务）和17%（OCR）的选择性降低目标行为，并将多模态安全攻击的成功率降低了24%，而对VQA性能无影响。引导这些特征平均比标准单层引导基线提高了3.6%（空间任务）和1.8%（OCR）的准确率。这些结果表明，多模态SAEs不仅可以作为可解释性工具，还可以作为审计、引导和控制MLLM行为以生成更安全、更强大的模型的机制。

articles.title: From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.
articles.titleCn: 从价值观到基准：评估用于政府用途的荷兰大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正日益被应用于政府环境，但现有评估框架很少能同时反映公共行政价值观和非英语环境的语言要求。我们提出了“Grip on LLMs”框架，这是一个与荷兰主要市镇组织的领域专家合作开发的、针对荷兰政府使用的系统评估套件。通过咨询委员会流程、用户研究和对公务员聊天机器人用户的调查，我们确定了六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本和训练数据透明度），并将它们操作化为一个涵盖超过30种多语言和荷兰特定模型的基准套件。我们的结果表明，没有单一模型能在所有维度上表现优异，且权衡不可避免：更高的质量始终伴随着更大的环境影响和财务成本，而偏见则基本独立于这两者。我们进一步发现，事实性（模型是否回答正确）和诚实性（模型是否承认自己不知道）受制于不同属性，高事实性并不必然意味着高诚实性。为了使这些发现对非技术受众具有可操作性，我们发布了一个公开可访问、用户友好的模型概览，旨在为政府LLM选择中涉及的所有利益相关者（从工程师到政策制定者）提供全面支持。

articles.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
articles.abstract: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution. Evaluating Taboo across several open-weight model families reveals that off-path robustness is heavily influenced by both parameter scale and post-training instruction alignment, with robustness generally improving with model size and alignment. Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.
articles.titleCn: 解码级禁忌：一种用于诊断大型语言模型鲁棒性的压力测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的评估通常集中于标准条件下的性能，从而营造出模型在狭窄且高度优化的生成路径上轻松行走的假象。然而在实际部署中，复杂的系统提示、安全护栏和结构约束会持续迫使模型偏离标准路径，导致基准分数与部署性能之间出现偏差。为解决这一问题，我们引入了解码级禁忌（Decoding-Level Taboo），这是一种零提示诊断压力测试，在运行时直接介入日志空间，迫使模型脱离标准路径。通过在词边界动态遮蔽主要候选词元，禁忌测试迫使机器进行迂回表达。跨多个开放权重模型系列的禁忌测试表明，偏离路径的鲁棒性受参数规模和训练后指令对齐的双重影响，鲁棒性通常随模型规模和对齐程度的提升而增强。除了本文展示的结果外，禁忌测试还为生成多样化合成数据集、压力测试运行时安全护栏以及在实际部署前审计模型可靠性提供了新颖的基础方法。

articles.title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling
articles.abstract: Test-time scaling often uses an external verifier, such as compilers and test cases in coding or trained value functions in robotics applications, to obtain high-quality rollouts. Verifier-free test-time scaling (or VF-TTS) is gaining extensive attention as a mechanism to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, primarily because we do not have access to such high-quality verifiers in many real-world applications. Among existing VF-TTS methods, confidence-based VF-TTS methods, which compute and rank rollouts solely by confidence, are particularly promising. Such methods introduce near-zero overhead for sample evaluation and require minimal access to internal model states, making the methods highly flexible across models and tasks. In this paper, we demonstrate a critical limitation of existing confidence-based VF-TTS methods by showing that such methods catastrophically break down on complex tasks. We observe a very interesting phenomenon: uniformly high confidence frequently indicates a failure to explore, favoring confidently wrong answers. To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.
articles.titleCn: 无验证器测试时扩展的协同性
articles.abstractCn: 测试时缩放通常使用外部验证器，例如编程中的编译器和测试用例，或机器人应用中的训练值函数，以获得高质量的轨迹。无验证器测试时缩放（或VF-TTS）作为一种增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理的机制，正受到广泛关注，主要因为我们许多现实应用中无法获得此类高质量的验证器。在现有的VF-TTS方法中，基于置信度的VF-TTS方法，仅通过置信度计算和排序轨迹，特别具有前景。这类方法在样本评估方面引入近乎零的开销，且仅需少量访问内部模型状态，使其在各种模型和任务中高度灵活。在本文中，我们通过展示现有基于置信度的VF-TTS方法在复杂任务上会灾难性失效，证明了其关键局限性。我们观察到一个非常有趣的现象：均匀的高置信度经常表明探索不足，倾向于选择自信但错误的答案。为解决这一问题，我们的核心见解是，鲁棒的认知搜索需要一个特定的置信度轨迹模式：这类方法在初期进行探索性分支，表现为初始置信度较低，并最终收敛到高最终置信度解。为实现这一见解，我们引入了协同性，这是一个新的选择框架，明确评估推理中置信度的时间不对称性。我们通过一种组合度量来实现这一点，该度量主动惩罚高初始置信度，同时严格要求最终确定性。涵盖研究生级数学问题和自由形式代码生成的广泛实验表明，协同性有效优于现有基线，验证了我们关于完成置信度的全新视角。

articles.title: Fusion Training for Mathematical Generalization in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) enables large language models to support both concise responses and long-form reasoning by unifying a non-thinking mode and a thinking mode within a single model. However, its training dynamics, including the \emph{data ratio} and \emph{training schedule} between the two modes, remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic study of TMF by analyzing the effects of the training schedule and data ratio between thinking and non-thinking modes. Focusing on mathematical problem solving, we construct a benchmark with multiple thinking-to-non-thinking data ratios and three training schedules. Our results reveal an asymmetric interaction between the two modes: increasing the ratio of non-thinking supervision reduces the accuracy of the thinking mode. We further show that different training schedules modulate this trade-off and that the optimal schedule depends on the data ratio. Finally, we quantify a negative correlation between non-thinking and thinking mode supervision, highlighting an inherent tension between these two modes. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective TMF training settings. All code and data are released to support further research at: \href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的数学泛化融合训练
articles.abstractCn: 思考模式融合（TMF）通过在单个模型内统一非思考模式与思考模式，使大型语言模型能够支持简洁回应和长篇推理。然而，其训练动态，包括两种模式之间的\emph{数据比例}和\emph{训练计划}，仍待深入探索。在本工作中，我们通过对思考与非思考模式之间的训练计划和数据比例进行系统性分析，对TMF进行了深入研究。聚焦于数学问题求解，我们构建了一个包含多种思考与非思考数据比例和三种训练计划的基准。我们的结果表明，两种模式之间存在非对称的交互作用：增加非思考监督的比例会降低思考模式的准确性。我们进一步表明，不同的训练计划调节了这种权衡，而最佳计划取决于数据比例。最后，我们量化了非思考与思考模式监督之间的负相关性，突显了这两种模式之间的固有张力。这些发现为设计有效的TMF训练设置提供了实用指导。所有代码和数据均已发布，以支持进一步研究，具体可在：\href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}获取。

articles.title: Towards Expert-level Medical AI for Real-time Video Consultations
articles.abstract: Audio-visual interaction is the standard for patient-physician consultations, enabling natural communication and effective assessment of illness through non-verbal cues. While text-based AI has shown promise, it discards essential perceptual dimensions and limits patients who cannot articulate symptoms in writing. Early efforts to extend medical AI to audio-visual interaction have demonstrated feasibility but not reached clinician-level performance. Here, we provide the first demonstration of expert-level AI in real-time clinical video consultations using AMIE (Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer) in a video configuration. AMIE (Video) is a Gemini-based multi-agent system integrating low-latency dialogue, clinical reasoning, and real-time audio-visual perception. To guide development, we established a taxonomy and automated evaluations for clinical audio-visual cues in telehealth settings. In a randomized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) study with 30 primary care physicians (PCPs), 15 patient actors and 100 clinical scenarios, we compared AMIE (Video), its text-only counterpart AMIE (Text), and PCPs consulting via video. Clinical evaluators rated AMIE (Video) on par or better than PCPs in history-taking, diagnosis, management, and physical observation and examination. Patient actors preferred AMIE's approach to assessing and explaining conditions, while PCPs were preferred for rapport and partnership building. In modality ablation, patient actors preferred AMIE (Video)'s interface over text chat for communicative effectiveness, convenience, and feeling understood. Limitations remain in fine anatomical precision, subtle affective nuances, and high-frequency movements. While further research is needed before real-world translation, these results mark an important milestone toward AI systems capable of augmenting care across the sensory complexity of clinical practice.
articles.titleCn: 面向实时视频咨询的专家级医疗人工智能
articles.abstractCn: 视听互动已成为医患咨询的标准，通过非语言线索实现自然沟通和有效病情评估。尽管基于文本的AI展现出潜力，但它舍弃了重要的感知维度，限制了无法书面描述症状的患者。早期将医疗AI扩展至视听互动的努力虽证明了可行性，但尚未达到临床医生水平。在此，我们首次展示了基于AMIE（医学智能探索器）的专家级AI在实时临床视频咨询中的表现，AMIE（视频）是一款基于Gemini的多智能体系统，集成了低延迟对话、临床推理和实时视听感知。为指导开发，我们建立了远程医疗环境下临床视听线索的分类体系和自动化评估方法。在一项包含30名全科医生（PCP）、15名患者演员和100个临床场景的随机客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）研究中，我们比较了AMIE（视频）、其纯文本版本AMIE（文本）以及通过视频咨询的PCP。临床评估者认为AMIE（视频）在病史采集、诊断、管理和体格检查方面表现与PCP相当或更优。患者演员更倾向于AMIE评估和解释病情的方式，而PCP则更擅长建立融洽关系和伙伴关系。在模态移除实验中，患者演员认为AMIE（视频）的界面在沟通效果、便捷性和被理解感方面优于文本聊天。尽管在精细解剖精度、细微情感细微差别和高频运动方面仍存在局限，但在实际应用转化前仍需进一步研究，这些结果标志着向开发能够跨越临床实践感官复杂性的AI辅助护理系统迈出了重要一步。

articles.title: Agentic Auto-Research is Fuzz Testing
articles.abstract: Autonomous research agents can generate experiments faster than researchers can validate them. Researchers have responded by scaling the proposer and ranking more samples with a learned judge or human reviewers. We argue that this *generate-and-rank* paradigm misses the problem of sparse feedback. Within a declared research problem, an agent follows the control loop of a greybox fuzzer: it proposes a candidate, executes it, observes feedback, and chooses what to try next. A fuzzer rarely finds a bug, but coverage makes partial progress observable on every execution. Fuzzers then use that signal to mutate inputs and allocate effort, rather than only to rank completed runs. Auto-research needs the same two capabilities. First, each experiment should expose a cheap, dense signal of epistemic progress before final scientific validation is available. Second, that signal should determine the next intervention so that the agent searches rather than repeatedly samples. Because the optimized progress signal is guidance rather than a verdict, final validation must still decide what counts as a discovery using evidence protected from adaptive reuse. We propose controlled tests of whether candidate signals predict validated progress, whether feedback-directed search yields more validated discoveries per unit cost than repeated sampling, and whether protected validation reduces false discoveries. Feedback architecture, not only generation, is a central bottleneck in auto-research.
articles.titleCn: 代理式自动研究是模糊测试
articles.abstractCn: 自主研究代理能够比研究人员更快地生成实验，研究人员为此通过扩大提议规模并利用学习型裁判或人工评审者对更多样本进行排序。我们认为这种“生成与排序”范式未能解决稀疏反馈的问题。在一个声明的研究问题中，代理遵循灰盒模糊器的控制循环：它提出候选方案，执行方案，观察反馈，并选择下一步尝试的内容。模糊器很少发现漏洞，但覆盖率使得每次执行的部分进展都可见。模糊器随后利用该信号变异输入并分配资源，而不仅仅是排序完成的运行。自动研究需要同样的两种能力。首先，每个实验在最终科学验证可用之前，都应暴露出廉价、密集的认知进展信号。其次，该信号应决定下一步干预，使代理进行搜索而非重复采样。由于优化的进展信号是指导而非裁决，最终验证仍需根据不受适应性重用保护的证据来决定什么才算发现。我们提出检验候选信号是否预测验证后的进展，反馈导向搜索是否比重复采样每单位成本产生更多验证发现，以及受保护的验证是否减少错误发现。反馈架构而非生成本身是自动研究中的核心瓶颈。

articles.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens are generated by the student but assigned near-zero probability by the teacher; their log-ratio corrections grow unbounded and destabilize the update. Student-deficit tokens, in contrast, are preferred by the teacher but rarely sampled by the student; their absence blocks the transfer of the teacher's reasoning patterns. To tackle these mismatch directions, we propose TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction), which applies bounded Hellinger shaping to suppress the most severe sampled excesses and an analytic teacher top-$K$ injection to restore deficient probability mass without requiring deficit tokens to be sampled. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with multiple Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, TIDE consistently outperforms standard OPD and recent token-selection and reward-shaping baselines. Moreover, the gains of TIDE are more pronounced under strong teacher-student mismatch, where it improves Avg@8 from 6.9% to 20.3%, reduces average response length by a factor of 3.6, and substantially reduces formatting failures. Code is available at https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE
articles.titleCn: 不匹配很重要：超越标记一致的在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）已成为现代大语言模型（LLM）后训练流程的核心组件，但我们揭示了一种失效模式：退化一致性，即学生利用重复循环实现与教师近乎完美的标记一致性，尽管其全局响应存在缺陷。因此，我们将重点从一致性转向师生不匹配，发现不匹配标记主要可分为两类：学生过剩标记和学生不足标记。学生过剩标记由学生生成，但被教师赋予近乎零的概率；其对数比校正无界增长并破坏更新。相比之下，学生不足标记被教师偏好，但学生很少采样；其缺失阻碍了教师推理模式的迁移。为解决这些不匹配方向，我们提出了TIDE（标记级独立不足-过剩校正），该技术应用有界Hellinger塑形来抑制最严重的采样过剩，并采用解析教师Top-K注入来恢复缺失的概率质量，而无需采样不足标记。在包含多个Qwen3师生对的多数学推理基准测试中，TIDE始终优于标准OPD以及最新的标记选择和奖励塑形基线。此外，在强烈的师生不匹配情况下，TIDE的收益更为显著，其将Avg@8从6.9%提升至20.3%，平均响应长度缩短3.6倍，并大幅减少格式错误。代码可在https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE获取。

articles.title: RA-FinBERT: Rule-aware LoRA adaptation for low-resource financial sentiment classification
articles.abstract: Financial sentiment analysis converts unstructured financial news into quantitative signals that can support market analysis and decision-making. Existing work on resource-efficient financial NLP has largely focused on compressing or adapting pretrained language models, with less attention to combining contextual representations with lightweight rule-derived features. This study develops Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with three continuous VADER-derived sentiment proportions (positive, negative, and neutral) and a source-level metadata feature. The standardized four-dimensional feature vector is directly concatenated with the 768-dimensional final-layer FinBERT [CLS] representation and passed through a lightweight classification head. This design introduces only 1,024 additional trainable weights relative to a structurally matched text-only FinBERT model. RA-FinBERT was evaluated against text-only FinBERT and a lightweight DistilBERT baseline for three-class sentiment classification of financial-news titles and descriptions. On the held-out test set, RA-FinBERT achieved 69.89% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.634, compared with 63.44% and 0.526 for text-only FinBERT. Neutral-class recall increased from 18.18% to 45.45%. The framework supports both CPU and GPU execution, offering a lightweight and practical approach to financial sentiment classification under constrained computational resources. These findings indicate that rule-derived sentiment information and source metadata can provide complementary signals to contextual FinBERT representations and improve performance with minimal additional model complexity.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Fan Zhang and Jiaming Li are co-first authors. Corresponding author: Jiaming Li
articles.titleCn: RA-FinBERT：规则感知LoRA适配用于低资源金融情感分类
articles.abstractCn: 金融情感分析将非结构化的金融新闻转化为支持市场分析和决策的量化信号。现有的资源高效型金融NLP研究主要集中于压缩或适配预训练语言模型，较少关注结合上下文表示与轻量级规则衍生特征。本研究开发了规则感知FinBERT（RA-FinBERT），这是一个参数高效的框架，它将低秩适配（LoRA）与三个连续的VADER衍生情感比例（正面、负面和中性）以及源级元数据特征相结合。标准化的四维特征向量直接与768维的FinBERT最终层[CLS]表示连接，并传递到一个轻量级的分类头。与结构匹配的纯文本FinBERT模型相比，该设计仅引入了1,024个额外的可训练权重。RA-FinBERT在金融新闻标题和描述的三类情感分类任务中，与纯文本FinBERT和轻量级DistilBERT基线进行了评估。在保留的测试集上，RA-FinBERT达到了69.89%的准确率和0.634的宏观F1分数，而纯文本FinBERT分别为63.44%和0.526。中性类召回率从18.18%提升至45.45%。该框架支持CPU和GPU执行，为在受限计算资源下的金融情感分类提供了一种轻量级且实用的方法。这些发现表明，规则衍生的情感信息和源元数据可以提供对上下文FinBERT表示的补充信号，并在最小的额外模型复杂度下提升性能。

articles.title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
articles.abstract: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.
articles.titleCn: Macaron-V1：迈向开放持续学习，融合自我改进与LoRA混合模型
articles.abstractCn: Macaron-V1是一个用于体验智能的开源代理模型家族：它能在真实环境中从经验中学习，并在部署后持续学习。该系统围绕两个系统目标组织。通过递归改进版本化的模型-适配器对来实现适应性，其中在一个配置中的经验通过外部合同进行评估，并用于构建其继任者。通过Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构来实现协作，该架构冻结基础模型，组合专家LoRA适配器，并为每个用户回合选择一个LoRA。旗舰Macaron-V1-Venti结合了744B GLM-5.2基础模型和四个用于聊天、代理、编码和GenUI的LoRA；基于Qwen3.6的Macaron-V1-Tall（50B）使用相同的设计进行本地部署。本报告将Macaron-V1呈现为一个跨越架构、算法和基础设施的协同设计系统。MoL架构通过可扩展的LoRA专家支持持续学习。该算法结合了模型-适配器协同设计和递归自我改进循环，包括UI4A组件原生的GenUI适配器、有状态动作子层、版本化的HCP合同以及代理式强化学习框架MindForge。支持基础设施包括训练后平台MinT、长上下文强化学习方法LongStraw以及用于稀疏MoE和DSA基础模型的稳定性技术。我们在个人智能、GenUI和通用能力基准上对Macaron-V1进行了评估，并与前沿基线进行了比较。我们的结果验证了当前系统，而持续学习和集体智能带来的增益仍为开放性问题。

articles.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
articles.abstract: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 基于变分学习的RLVR参数探索
articles.abstractCn: 探索一直是强化学习研究的重点。近年来，越来越多的证据表明，它也是LLM强化学习配方中的一个重要成分，能够显著影响下游性能。许多现有方法通过控制动作空间中的探索来实施，例如使用温度缩放。然而，这些方法无法重新排序标记，只能影响输出分布的方差。这限制了探索，并可能导致发散或训练停滞。在此，我们研究了参数空间探索，其中通过从可能探索不同轨迹的后验分布中采样不同的策略来生成轨迹。然后，采样较少或更多多样化的策略成为探索的补充控制杠杆。我们引入了一组称为扰动参数策略优化（3PO）的方法，这些方法使用不同的采样策略和不同的轨迹分组来进行奖励估计。在数学推理和代码生成任务上对OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B进行的实验表明，这些方法在接近相同的FLOPs成本下，始终比标准GRPO提高了平均下游性能。此外，使用多个参数样本在训练过程中始终比GRPO和动作空间基线产生更少的零优势组和畸形或不正确的轨迹。总体而言，我们的工作提供了证据，表明参数空间探索可以提高LLM的强化学习。

articles.title: SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring
articles.abstract: As AI coding agents take on increasingly complex, long-horizon software engineering tasks, existing benchmarks are rapidly saturating and their evaluation quality has come under serious scrutiny: a recent audit found that nearly 60% of unsolved SWE-bench Verified instances contain flawed tests -- either overly narrow tests that reject correct solutions or overly broad tests that check unstated requirements -- and that frontier models can verbatim reproduce gold patches from training data. Code refactoring, which requires coordinated, behavior-preserving changes across many files, offers a substantially harder and more realistic test of agent capability, yet remains underserved by current benchmarks. We introduce SWE-Bench ProMax, an expert-curated, multilingual code refactoring benchmark of 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, and Rust). Every instance undergoes rigorous, multi-stage curation that directly addresses the quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow and overly broad tests. Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding a benchmark of challenging, large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance, substantially exceeding the scale of existing benchmarks. Experiments with frontier models under two agent scaffolds show that the best model achieves only 41.2% resolve rate, confirming that SWE-Bench ProMax presents a meaningful and unsaturated challenge for current AI coding agents. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax.

articles.titleCn: SWE-Bench ProMax：在大规模多语言代码重构中测试代理
articles.abstractCn: 随着AI编程代理承担日益复杂、长期软件工程任务，现有基准测试正迅速饱和，其评估质量也受到严重质疑：近期审计发现，近60%未解决的SWE-bench验证实例包含有缺陷的测试——要么是过于狭窄的测试会拒绝正确的解决方案，要么是过于宽泛的测试会检查未声明的需求——并且前沿模型能够逐字复制训练数据中的黄金补丁。代码重构，需要跨多个文件进行协调、行为保持的变更，为代理能力提供了实质上更困难、更现实的测试，但现有基准测试仍未能充分覆盖这一领域。我们引入了SWE-Bench ProMax，这是一个由专家精选的多语言代码重构基准测试，包含170个实例，源自七种编程语言（Python、Java、TypeScript、Go、C、C++和Rust）的真实提交。每个实例都经过严格的多阶段筛选，直接针对先前基准测试中发现的质量问题：问题描述从零开始重写，以提供精确、无歧义的规定，测试套件经过人工审查以移除过于狭窄和过于宽泛的测试。复杂度不足或跨文件范围有限的任务被过滤掉，最终形成一个包含挑战性、大规模重构任务的基准测试，每个实例平均修改11.4个文件和261.6行代码，显著超过了现有基准测试的规模。在两种代理框架下的前沿模型实验表明，最佳模型的解决率为41.2%，证实SWE-Bench ProMax为当前AI编程代理提供了一个有意义且未饱和的挑战。我们的基准测试可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax获取。

articles.title: Comparing British and American Audio Description of Movies
articles.abstract: Narrating the visual component of movies is known as audio description. It is a narrative technique designed to enable blind and visually impaired individuals to follow the story. However, it is far more constrained than most narratives: the descriptions not only need to convey the story in the movie, but they must also fit into gaps between dialogue and they need to conform to guidelines that exist in each region. In this work, we compare audio description created in the United Kingdom against audio description created in the United States. We use guidelines written for these two regions, alongside the impressions from a practitioner in the field, to motivate specific hypotheses about the differences. We test these hypotheses against our pre-existing corpus, which provides both human-authored American and British audio description for each of 206 movies. Results provide quantitative evidence to uphold all tested hypotheses, including differences in lexicon, the use of the progressive aspect, the use of passive constructions, the use of subjective adjectives and modifiers, when characters are named, how scenes are cued, and degree of overlap with movie dialogue and music. Our work offers a quantitative lens into the narrative technique of audio description.
articles.titleCn: 比较英国与美国电影音频描述
articles.abstractCn: 电影视觉成分的叙述被称为音频描述。这是一种叙事技巧，旨在帮助盲人和视力障碍人士理解故事。然而，它比大多数叙事受到更多的限制：描述不仅需要传达电影中的故事，还必须填补对话之间的空白，并且需要符合每个地区的现有规范。在这项工作中，我们比较了英国制作的音频描述与美国制作的音频描述。我们使用了这两个地区制定的规范，以及该领域一位从业者的看法，来提出关于差异的具体假设。我们使用预先存在的语料库来验证这些假设，该语料库为206部电影的每一部都提供了人类创作的美国和英国音频描述。结果提供了定量的证据来支持所有测试的假设，包括词汇差异、进行时态的使用、被动结构的使用、主观形容词和修饰语的使用、角色命名方式、场景提示方式以及与电影对话和音乐的重叠程度。我们的工作为音频描述的叙事技巧提供了一个定量的视角。

articles.title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
articles.abstract: Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks. To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations. We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.
articles.titleCn: KGCaRe：基于LLMs的自动知识图谱构建与上下文检索的可解释复杂条件问答
articles.abstractCn: 使用大型语言模型（LLMs）和检索增强生成（RAG）来回答复杂的条件性问题仍然是一个挑战，特别是在专业领域环境中，通用LLMs和RAG往往表现不佳。我们假设通过从文档和知识图谱（KGs）中提取非结构化和结构化知识来增强RAG，可以改善此类任务的推理和答案准确性。为了验证这一点，我们提出了KGCaRe，这是一种结合了神经检索和LLM生成的KG上的符号推理的混合方法。KGCaRe使用多提示提取策略从文档中构建一个KG，并将其存储在图数据库中。同时，文档被嵌入到向量存储中以实现神经检索。KGCaRe执行由LLM指导的创新性迭代图遍历，以提取相关三元组、修剪不相关信息，并在初始遍历未能提供足够的上下文来生成答案时，使用额外的线索实体重新遍历图。从KG中提取的相关三元组（以路径形式）以及语义检索到的文本段落随后被输入到自定义的KGCaRe提示中，以生成复杂条件性问题的答案和解释。我们在两个复杂的条件性问答数据集上评估了KGCaRe。我们的结果表明，KGCaRe在这些数据集上始终优于现有基线，包括Vanilla LLM、Code Prompt、Text Prompt、Think-on-Graph、Vanilla RAG和HybridContextQA，涵盖了Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5和GPT-4o等多种LLMs。我们公开发布了我们为实施所提出的KGCaRe方法而开发的软件管道。

articles.title: PragMatch: Separating Pragmatic Incongruity from Cross-Modal Mismatch in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason about relationships between images and text or rely on superficial correlations, known as shortcut learning. This question is particularly important for multimodal sarcasm detection, where successful prediction depends on recognizing pragmatic incongruity rather than treating sarcasm as simple image-text mismatch. We introduce PragMatch, a controlled benchmark of 3,000 image-text pairs derived from MMSD2.0, including original sarcastic examples and constructed literal and hard-negative pairs. We identify influential shortcut cues through systematic masking and evaluate their impact through targeted injection experiments. Our results show that LVLM predictions are sensitive to lexical, OCR-derived and stylistic cues, with injected surface signals causing substantial changes in model predictions despite unchanged underlying image-text relationships. Our findings reveal limitations in current LVLMs while PragMatch provides a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal pragmatic reasoning beyond surface-level image-text alignment.
articles.titleCn: PragMatch：在大规模视觉语言模型中区分语用不一致与跨模态不匹配
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态基准测试中表现出色，但它们是否真正推理图像与文本之间的关系，还是依赖表面关联（即捷径学习）尚不明确。这个问题对于多模态讽刺检测尤为重要，因为成功的预测依赖于识别语用上的不协调，而不是将讽刺简单视为图像-文本不匹配。我们引入了PragMatch，这是一个由MMSD2.0衍生出的3000个图像-文本对构成的受控基准，包括原始讽刺示例以及构建的直白和硬负对。通过系统性的掩码识别出有影响力的捷径线索，并通过针对性的注入实验评估其影响。我们的结果表明，LVLM的预测对词汇、OCR衍生和风格线索敏感，尽管底层图像-文本关系未变，注入的表面信号仍导致模型预测发生显著变化。我们的研究揭示了当前LVLM的局限性，而PragMatch为评估超越表面层图像-文本对齐的多模态语用推理提供了系统化的测试平台。

articles.title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification
articles.abstract: Real-time MRI makes it possible to observe vocal-tract articulation during speech, but mapping these articulatory patterns to phonetic and phonological categories remains challenging. We investigate whether PhonoQ, an audio-based model trained to recognize structured phonological features, provides useful information for audio--articulatory modeling. Specifically, we extract representations from PhonoQ's Conformer module, whose training is shaped by supervision for manner, place, voicing, and vowel features. Using articulatory contours with synchronized audio-derived features, we compare WavLM-large and HuBERT-large baselines with models that incorporate PhonoQ-derived representations. Across unseen-speech and unseen-subject settings, these features improve macro-F1 for phonological targets including manner, place, voicing, vowel height, and vowel backness, and also improve fine-grained 39-phoneme classification. In a contour-only inference setting, audio-derived teacher supervision yields modest but consistent gains over contour-only training, indicating that phonological information from synchronized audio can be partially transferred to articulatory models. Finally, posterior analyses show interpretable surface-sensitive patterns consistent with flapping-like /t/ realizations, /t/-/r/ retraction or affrication, and nasal place assimilation.
articles.titleCn: 用于音频-发音rtMRI语音分类的结构化语音表征
articles.abstractCn: 实时核磁共振成像技术使得在说话过程中观察声道发音成为可能，但将这些发音模式映射到音位和音系类别仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了基于音频训练的PhonoQ模型（该模型用于识别结构化音系特征）是否能为音频-发音建模提供有用信息。具体而言，我们从PhonoQ的Conformer模块中提取表征，该模块的训练受到发音方式、发音部位、清浊和元音特征等监督。利用与同步音频特征相结合的发音轮廓，我们将WavLM-large和HuBERT-large基线模型与包含PhonoQ衍生表征的模型进行比较。在未见过语音和未见过说话人设置下，这些特征提高了音位目标（包括发音方式、发音部位、清浊、元音高度和元音后置度）的宏观F1值，并提升了细粒度39音素分类的准确率。在仅使用轮廓的推理设置下，音频衍生教师监督相较于仅使用轮廓的训练带来了适度但一致的增益，表明同步音频中的音系信息可以部分转移至发音模型。最后，后验分析显示出与类似弹舌/t/实现、/t/-/r/退缩或塞擦化以及鼻音部位同化等表面敏感模式相一致的、可解释的规律。

articles.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
articles.abstract: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.
articles.titleCn: 品种：一个对比性和本地化导向的翻译基准，用于研究污染和本地化鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 多语言翻译基准通常以英语为源语言，翻译成其他语言，将语言对视为评估单元——这种设计容易随时间产生污染，并忽略地域和文化因素。因此，我们提倡源对比评估，并以Cultivar（FLORES的本地化子集）为例实现这一评估方法，它支持特定地域的翻译评估。当与未本地化的版本配对时，性能差异有助于探测数据污染和本地化鲁棒性。我们对32个开放权重模型进行基准测试，发现专业翻译模型鲁棒性较差，少数模型可能过拟合FLORES，且无论语言如何，模型通常翻译美国内容比其他地域内容更好。

articles.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
articles.abstract: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.
articles.titleCn: 重述：面向电影逼真音频描述生成
articles.abstractCn: 音频描述（AD）是对视频关键视觉内容的口头叙述，旨在为视障观众提供无障碍体验。与标准视频字幕不同，音频描述是一项结构化的编辑任务：描述必须插入对话的空白处，并且只能传达理解所讲述故事所必需的信息。然而，现有方法在人工环境中生成音频描述，其中描述的内容和时间预先指定，将任务简化为片段级字幕。它们进一步依赖嘈杂的转录和对齐流程，并且缺乏建模叙事背景所需的丰富并行数据。我们引入了一种新的音频描述生成方法，其中模型必须联合决定描述什么以及何时进行描述。为此，我们提出了REFRAMED，一个包含2023个视频的高质量数据集，涵盖206部电影的3302个场景，配有专业音频描述文本（美式和英式版本）、专业字幕和同步剧本。我们还提供了一组经过人工筛选的挑战集，将完整电影与多个音频描述参考配对，并附带利用对话空白和多参考比较的评价协议。使用最先进的音频描述系统和多模态大语言模型进行的实验表明，它们优于简单的基线，但远未达到专家人类的水平。我们的数据集和基准为视频理解研究建立了新的基础。

articles.title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.

articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型如何评判社交吸引力？基于理论指导的人格评分的多LLM和人类证据
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于执行传统上由人类进行的客观评估，但它们作为社会评判者的有效性尚不明确。本文探讨了LLMs能否根据从十个心理和关系构念构建、并分为三个层级（社会吸引力、社会混合性、社会不吸引力）的理论基础性人设档案来评估社会吸引力。我们在两项研究中检验了LLMs的评分，并在第三项研究中将其与人类判断进行比较。在研究1中，34个LLMs在三次重复运行中对12个人设档案进行了评分。尽管一些模型在整体评分上倾向于给出较高或较低的评价，但它们在运行间表现出很强的稳定性、一致的三层级排序，以及在相对人设排序上高度的一致性。研究2通过使用六对人名与代词匹配的人设档案对性别呈现的敏感性进行了检验，并使用一个仅含中性名字的代词测试，发现两种分析均未发现显著效应。研究3中，198名人类参与者对研究2中的六个人设档案进行了评价。他们的评分重现了三层级结构，并遵循了与LLMs一致的档案排序。然而，LLMs对吸引力人设的评分比人类更积极，对人设的评分比人类更消极，而两组均未显示出性别呈现的显著整体效应。

articles.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
articles.abstract: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft model is contained within the verifier. We validate our approach by training a Matryoshka suite comprising 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models. Our suite is on par with independently trained baselines on benchmark performance and validation and out-of-domain perplexities, while using 36% less training compute and improving the throughput of speculative decoding by 14-26%. We also ablate key architectural choices, offering guidance for building strong Matryoshka LM suites.
articles.titleCn: 套娃语言模型系列
articles.abstractCn: 经典的语言模型套件训练需要分别训练每个模型并独立部署。我们通过将不同规模的子模型堆叠成一个单一的嵌套架构进行端到端训练，从而提高了训练和推理效率。这种Matryoshka训练框架减少了套件的总参数数量，能够在每一步训练中从最大的子模型向所有较小的子模型进行低成本蒸馏，并且非常适合推测性解码，因为草案模型包含在验证器内部。我们通过训练一个包含500M、1.5B和3B子模型的Matryoshka套件来验证我们的方法。我们的套件在基准性能、验证和域外困惑度方面与独立训练的基线相当，同时训练计算量减少了36%，并提高了推测性解码的吞吐量14-26%。我们还消融了关键的架构选择，为构建强大的Matryoshka LM套件提供了指导。

articles.title: VeriForge: Mitigating Latent Knowledge Gaps in Narrative Drafting via Mixed-Initiative Scaffolding
articles.abstract: Great fiction earns its verisimilitude through precise details, from how a longsword is gripped to pierce armor gaps to why a bleeding corpse cannot yet smell of decay, weaving domain expertise into the fabric of invented worlds. Current AI writing tools offer limited support for discovering and integrating unfamiliar domain knowledge into narrative. They require explicit queries that authors cannot formulate, generate finished prose that risks homogenizing voice, or assist only within the boundaries of what authors already know. We argue that AI should reveal latent knowledge gaps to writers while preserving their agency to transform discovered knowledge into authentic prose. Grounded in formative interviews with 9 fiction writers, we present VeriForge, a mixed-initiative writing system that divides cognitive labor so that the system assumes initiative over domain discovery while the author retains full initiative over narrative synthesis. VeriForge realizes this through three complementary mechanisms. Proactive inline highlighting flags potential knowledge gaps as authors draft. Dual-stream querying pairs conversational responses with source-anchored Knowledge Cards for direct fact extraction. A spatial Knowledge Canvas allows authors to organize and connect discovered knowledge across their writing. These mechanisms are powered by a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation pipeline grounded in domain-specific source materials. A within-subjects user study (N=12) provides preliminary evidence that this paradigm helps authors recognize previously overlooked knowledge gaps, supports creative exploration, and is perceived by expert raters to produce passages with stronger domain grounding in a controlled cold-start writing task.
articles.titleCn: VeriForge：通过混合式协作脚手架减轻叙事草拟中的潜在知识差距
articles.abstractCn: 优秀的小说通过精确的细节来获得真实感，从如何握住长剑刺穿盔甲缝隙，到为何流血的尸体尚未散发出腐败的气息，将专业领域知识编织进虚构世界的经纬之中。当前的AI写作工具在帮助作者发现并整合不熟悉的领域知识以融入叙事方面提供有限的支持。它们需要作者提出明确的查询，而作者往往无法自行构思；它们生成的成品文本存在同质化风格的风险；或者仅限于作者已知的知识范围内提供辅助。我们主张，AI应当向作者揭示潜在的知识空白，同时保留作者将发现的知识转化为真实文本的自主权。基于对9位小说家的形成性访谈，我们提出了VeriForge——一个混合主导的写作系统，该系统将认知劳动进行划分，使系统主导领域发现，而作者则保留对叙事综合的完全主导权。VeriForge通过三种互补的机制实现这一目标：主动的行内高亮功能在作者撰写时标记潜在的知识空白；双流查询功能将对话式响应与源锚定的知识卡片相结合，实现直接的事实提取；空间知识画布允许作者组织并连接写作中发现的各类知识。这些机制由基于领域特定源材料的图检索增强生成流程提供支持。一项被试内用户研究（N=12）初步表明，该范式有助于作者识别先前被忽视的知识空白，支持创意探索，并且在受控的冷启动写作任务中，被专家评审员认为生成的段落具有更强的领域基础。

articles.title: Listwise Cross-Encoder Fine-Tuning vs. Agentic Instruction Tuning for LLM Rerankers: A Systematic Study in Medical Procedure Reranking
articles.abstract: Reranking medical procedures against patient queries is a critical component of health insurance information retrieval, complicated by a substantial lexical gap between patient language and clinical nomenclature. We present a systematic comparison of two reranking paradigms for this production task: (1) small cross-encoders (MedCPT, MiniLM-L12) fine-tuned with listwise learning-to-rank objectives across layer freezing configurations, and (2) Qwen3-Reranker-4B, a 4B-parameter instruction reranker whose prompt is iteratively refined via an agentic optimization loop driven by GPT-4.1. On a purpose-built dataset of 2,647 queries across 708 insurance services, we find that a 109M-parameter cross-encoder fine-tuned with ListNet outperforms the 4B-parameter model by 2.6 percentage points on NDCG@3 and 13.3 points on Spearman correlation - at 37x fewer parameters. We report practical findings, a scalable LLM based dataset construction pipeline, and deployment trade-offs relevant to production reranking systems. We release our code and a sample dataset to support reproducibility and adaptation to other domains.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/matanf-healthee/listwise-crossencoder-reranking
articles.titleCn: 基于列表的交叉编码器微调与智能体指令微调在LLM排序器中的医学程序排序：一项系统性研究
articles.abstractCn: 针对患者查询重新排序医疗程序是健康保险信息检索的关键环节，其复杂性源于患者语言与临床术语之间存在的巨大词汇差距。我们针对这一生成任务，对两种重新排序范式进行了系统性比较：（1）经过列表式学习排序目标微调的小型跨编码器（MedCPT、MiniLM-L12），在冻结层配置下进行微调；（2）Qwen3-Reranker-4B，一个4B参数的指令重新排序模型，其提示通过由GPT-4.1驱动的代理优化循环进行迭代优化。在一个包含708项保险服务、2647个查询的专用数据集上，我们发现一个经过ListNet微调的109M参数跨编码器在NDCG@3上比4B参数模型高出2.6个百分点，在Spearman相关性上高出13.3个百分点——参数量仅为后者的37分之一。我们报告了实际发现、基于LLM的可扩展数据集构建流程，以及与生产重新排序系统相关的部署权衡。我们发布代码和示例数据集，以支持可重复性和对其他领域的适应性。

articles.title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics
articles.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) is essential for agent interactions, yet existing evaluations either rely on static scenarios that oversimplify mental-state reasoning or interactive settings that provide limited diagnostic insight. We present Avalon-ToM-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark that operationalizes ToM through the asymmetric-information mechanics of The Resistance: Avalon.
