Across this corpus, Bengali requires (1.56\times) as many GPT-4o tokens as English, reducing a nominal 128k-token context window to an effective 82k-token English-equivalent capacity for the same semantic content. With the Qwen2.5 and Mistral tokenizers, Bengali requires up to (4.5\times) the English token count. Yoruba, despite using the Latin script, exhibits the highest GPT-4o tokenization premium at (2.37\times), indicating that tokenization inequity cannot be explained by script family alone. These results demonstrate that tokenization can create measurable economic and functional barriers, highlighting the need to treat tokenization as an equity-relevant infrastructure layer for underserved language communities, particularly where educational systems depend on low-cost or offline-capable AI tools.
articles.titleCn: 衡量标记化溢价：为服务不足的语言社区进行成本审计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为通用教育和技术辅助系统，但其底层基础设施并未平等对待各种语言。一个尚未充分研究的差异来源是分词：语义等价的内容在不同语言中可能需要显著不同的分词数量，这会影响API成本、延迟以及在模型被调用前可用的上下文长度。我们介绍了分词公平性审计（TEA），这是一个可重复的基准，用于衡量技术辅导内容中的分词溢价。TEA对三种广泛使用的分词器——GPT-4o的o200k基础版、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B——在一个包含120个项目的Python调试语料库上进行了评估，该语料库从英语翻译成了孟加拉语、印地语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和约鲁巴语。孟加拉语和印地语作为主要验证案例，而其余语言则提供了跨脚本和跨语系的探索性比较。在这个语料库中，孟加拉语需要的GPT-4o分词数量是英语的（1.56倍），将名义上的128k分词上下文窗口减少到有效的82k分词的英语等价容量，以承载相同语义内容。使用Qwen2.5和Mistral分词器，孟加拉语需要的英语分词数量高达（4.5倍）。尽管约鲁巴语使用拉丁字母，但其GPT-4o分词溢价最高，达到（2.37倍），表明分词不平等不能仅由脚本家族来解释。这些结果表明，分词可以造成可衡量的经济和功能障碍，突显了需要将分词视为对服务不足语言社区具有公平性相关性的基础设施层，特别是在教育系统依赖低成本或离线AI工具的地区。

articles.title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
articles.abstract: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.
articles.titleCn: 连接语义与重建：统一手语翻译与生成
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，手语（SL）研究领域的最新进展显示，手语理解（SLU）的多个子任务，如孤立手语识别（ISLR）、连续手语识别（CSLR）和手语翻译（SLT），正朝着在单一框架内统一的方向发展，从而取得了显著进展。与此同时，手语生成（SLP），即从文本生成手语序列，也吸引了越来越多的关注。这自然引出了一个重要问题：手语理解和生成是否能在单一框架内统一？与统一SLU子任务相比，这个问题具有更大的挑战性。现有的SLU任务大体上共享相同的映射方向，即从手语输入到语言输出，而SLT和SLP则处于相反的手语-文本映射方向。因此，统一的框架必须解决两个关键挑战：（1）通过支持语言抽象和运动重建的共享手语分词器，弥合连续手语运动和离散文本标记之间的模态差距；（2）学习一个单一的条件下回归模型，该模型可以接受手语或文本作为输入，并在相反的模态中生成相应的目标序列。为此，我们提出了Uni-SLTP，这是一个用于SLT和SLP的统一框架，包含两个关键组件：（1）一个共享的手语分词器，将手语序列转换为离散标记和潜在表示，捕捉语义和重建信息；（2）一个统一的自回归生成模型，将这两个任务都表述为条件序列生成。在广泛使用的公共数据集上的实验表明，Uni-SLTP在手语生成（SLP）方面实现了卓越的运动精度，同时保持了具有竞争力的手语翻译（SLT）性能。

articles.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
articles.abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE), a structured experience-management framework that aligns experience organization with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents. Specifically, ToE organizes the experience into a shared tree of analytical perspectives and reasoning paths, whose reliability is calibrated through environmental outcomes to support systematic updating, transfer, and efficient retrieval. The experimental results on \textsc{Game of 24} and \textsc{FinEvolveBench} show that ToE substantially improves both problem-solving performance and efficiency. On \textsc{Game of 24}, ToE achieves a 31.4\% relative improvement in accuracy over the experience-free ToT baseline. On \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, ToE improves tsIC by an average of 41.24\% over the experience-free pipeline across 12 evaluation settings, whereas conventional experience-management methods often underperform experience-free baselines.
articles.titleCn: 经验树：自进化智能体的分层经验管理
articles.abstractCn: 持续的自我进化需要大型语言模型智能体将环境交互转化为可靠且可复用的经验。现有方法通常通过优化单个轨迹或从相关轨迹中抽象共享知识来改进经验，但它们的经验表示往往与底层推理过程脱节。这限制了反馈归因、跨任务迁移以及更新和检索效率，尤其是在具有结果级反馈的复杂推理任务中。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了\textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience（ToE），这是一个结构化的经验管理框架，它将经验组织与大型语言模型智能体的分层推理过程相一致。具体而言，ToE将经验组织成一个共享的分析视角和推理路径树，其可靠性通过环境结果进行校准，以支持系统化的更新、迁移和高效检索。在\textsc{24点游戏}和\textsc{FinEvolveBench}上的实验结果表明，ToE显著提高了问题解决性能和效率。在\textsc{24点游戏}上，ToE在无经验ToT基线的基础上实现了31.4%的相对准确率提升。在\textsc{FinEvolveBench}上，ToE在12个评估设置中，通过无经验管道平均将tsIC提高了41.24%，而传统的经验管理方法通常表现不如无经验基线。

articles.title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
articles.abstract: Users of modern platforms repeatedly need summaries of recent dialogue, but the window rarely contains enough context to be interpreted on its own. We formalize this setting as streaming dialogue summarization, where a system must summarize a current window using selective memory from an unbounded history under a fixed budget. We show that the central challenge is not how much history is accessed, but whether memory recovers the evidence that the current window presupposes. We construct a benchmark and evaluation protocol that separately assesses whether memory contains gap-resolving evidence and whether the generated summary reflects it. We propose ReMEMBER, a missing-evidence memory framework that conditions retrieval on unresolved window dependencies and refines retrieved chunks into evidence-dense memory under a fixed budget. Experiments on dialogues with histories up to 160K tokens show that ReMEMBER improves memory recall and gap-resolution completeness over memory construction baselines under the same budget.
articles.titleCn: 不要回滚：流式对话摘要的缺失证据记忆
articles.abstractCn: 现代平台用户反复需要近期对话的摘要，但窗口中很少包含足够的上下文以供独立解读。我们将此场景形式化为流式对话摘要，其中系统必须在固定预算下，使用有限的历史选择性记忆来总结当前窗口。我们证明核心挑战并非访问多少历史，而是记忆能否恢复当前窗口所隐含的证据。我们构建了一个基准和评估协议，分别评估记忆是否包含解决信息缺失的证据，以及生成的摘要是否反映了这些证据。我们提出了ReMEMBER，一个缺失证据记忆框架，该框架基于未解决的窗口依赖关系进行检索，并在固定预算下将检索到的片段细化为证据密集型记忆。在包含高达160K token历史的对话实验中显示，ReMEMBER在相同预算下比记忆构建基线提高了记忆召回率和信息缺失解决完整性。

articles.title: PolicyKG: An Agentic LLM Pipeline for Translating Institutional Policies into SHACL Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Institutional policies stay in natural language while the systems that check compliance demand machine-readable constraints. Bridging that gap is still done by hand. PolicyKG closes the loop. It is an LLM pipeline that reads a policy PDF, classifies each sentence as an obligation, permission, or prohibition, lifts the label into first-order deontic logic, and emits SHACL constraints. Four stages run on a LangGraph state machine with per-stage validators. The piece that matters most is the Corpus Adapter: a YAML vocabulary registry that grounds LLM predicates in a target ontology. Retargeting to a new domain means swapping the registry, not retraining a model. On the Asian Institute of Technology Policies and Procedures corpus (1,663 sentences, 443 rules), PolicyKG reaches 86.9% deontic classification accuracy (Cohen's kappa = .709). Three annotators independently re-label a 50-item sample and agree at Fleiss' kappa = .844. SHACL shape correctness on a 69-shape subset is F1 = .866. The FOL path handles 79.2% of rules; the rest go through a direct NL-to-SHACL fallback. We audited every one of the 443 rules for second- or higher-order constructs. An automated regex checklist flagged none, and a first-author pass on the 92 FOL-fallback cases confirmed the same. The exact upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the true HOL rate is 0.67%. This is an audit finding for one corpus, not a proof of FOL sufficiency for institutional policy. Swapping the AIT registry for a GDPR registry raises exact property alignment from 1/15 to 11/15 (Fisher's exact p < .001; Cohen's h = 1.53). On the LexDeMod lease-contract benchmark (N = 200), Macro F1 drops to .370 because lease English uses "shall be entitled" for permission -- exactly the vocabulary mismatch registry swap is meant to fix. Repeated runs produce hash-identical SHACL outputs.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Under review at IJCKG 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
articles.titleCn: PolicyKG：一种将机构政策翻译为SHACL知识图谱的智能体式大型语言模型流程
articles.abstractCn: 机构政策通常以自然语言表述，而合规性检查系统则需要机器可读的约束。目前，填补这一差距仍需人工操作。PolicyKG系统则实现了闭环管理。它是一个基于大型语言模型的处理流程，能够读取政策PDF文件，将每句话分类为义务、权限或禁止，将标签提升到一阶道义逻辑，并输出SHACL约束。该流程包含四个阶段，每个阶段都运行在LangGraph状态机中，并设有阶段验证器。其中最关键的部分是语料库适配器：一个YAML词汇表注册中心，它将大型语言模型的谓词与目标本体关联起来。若需转向新的领域，只需更换注册中心，无需重新训练模型。在亚洲理工学院政策与程序语料库（包含1663个句子、443条规则）上，PolicyKG达到了86.9%的道义分类准确率（Cohen's kappa = 0.709）。三位标注员独立重新标注了一个包含50个项目的样本，Fleiss' kappa系数达到了0.844。在69个形状子集上，SHACL形状的正确性达到了F1 = 0.866。FOL路径处理了79.2%的规则，其余规则通过直接的自然语言到SHACL的回退路径处理。我们对全部443条规则中的二阶或更高阶结构进行了审计。自动正则表达式检查未发现任何问题，而第一作者对92个FOL回退案例的检查也确认了这一点。真正的HOL率的精确95% Clopper-Pearson上限为0.67%。这是针对一个语料库的审计结果，并非证明FOL对机构政策的充分性。将AIT注册中心更换为GDPR注册中心后，精确属性对齐率从1/15提升到11/15（Fisher's exact p < 0.001；Cohen's h = 1.53）。在LexDeMod租赁合同基准测试（N = 200）中，Macro F1降至0.370，因为租赁英语使用"shall be entitled"表示权限——这正是词汇表不匹配注册中心更换旨在解决的问题。重复运行会生成哈希值相同的SHACL输出。

articles.title: ELICITED: EHR-grounded Longitudinal Interactive Conversations for Information-seeking Triage Evaluation and Decision-making
articles.abstract: Emergency-department (ED) triage requires clinicians to rapidly identify patients who need immediate attention, determine who can safely wait, and prioritize limited clinical resources. At presentation, however, information may be limited to a chief complaint and initial vital signs. Clinically important details, including symptom onset and progression, associated symptoms, medical history, and medication use, are often obtained through focused conversation. Effective triage therefore requires clinicians to identify information gaps, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and update their assessment as new evidence becomes available. Most existing ED benchmarks evaluate acuity prediction from a fixed clinical snapshot. Although this formulation measures predictive performance after patient information has been assembled, it does not capture the interactive process through which triage-relevant evidence is elicited and interpreted. Existing medical dialogue datasets support the study of clinical communication, but dialogue statements are not always linked to temporally ordered events in the electronic health record (EHR). We introduce EHR2Dial-Triage, an agentic conversation-generation framework and benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV-ED. The framework constructs triage conversations under explicit role-based and temporal information boundaries. Each accepted patient disclosure is linked to its supporting EHR event and the first dialogue turn at which it becomes available. EHR2Dial-Triage enables controlled evaluation of information elicitation, evidence use, five-level Emergency Severity Index prediction, and patient-facing communication across models and patient personas. It provides a structured setting for studying conversational triage as a dynamic process of clinical information acquisition, reasoning, and communication.
articles.titleCn: 基于EHR的纵向交互式对话，用于信息寻求的初步评估和决策
articles.abstractCn: 急诊科分诊需要临床医生迅速识别需要立即处理的病人，确定哪些病人可以安全等待，并优先配置有限的临床资源。然而，在就诊时，信息可能仅限于主要症状和初步生命体征。临床重要细节，包括症状发作和进展、伴随症状、病史和用药情况，通常通过有针对性的对话获取。因此，有效的分诊要求临床医生识别信息缺失，提出适当的后续问题，并在新证据出现时更新评估。现有的急诊科基准主要从固定的临床快照评估病情严重程度预测。尽管这种模式在病人信息收集后测量预测性能，但它并未捕捉到分诊相关证据的引出和解读的互动过程。现有的医疗对话数据集支持临床交流研究，但对话陈述并不总是与电子健康记录（EHR）中的时间顺序事件相关联。我们介绍了EHR2Dial-Triage，这是一个基于MIMIC-IV-ED的智能对话生成框架和基准。该框架在明确的角色和时间信息边界下构建分诊对话。每个被接受的病人陈述都与支持其的EHR事件以及其首次可用的对话回合相关联。EHR2Dial-Triage能够跨模型和病人角色，对信息引出、证据使用、五级急诊严重指数预测和面向病人的沟通进行受控评估。它为研究对话分诊作为临床信息获取、推理和沟通的动态过程提供了一个结构化环境。

articles.title: How People Evaluate AI-, Expert-, and Peer-Style Financial Advice
articles.abstract: As generative AI increasingly becomes a common source of daily decision-making, including financial choices, it is critical to understand how people evaluate AI-generated financial advice. We conducted a preregistered vignette experiment (N = 285) in which substantive financial content---including facts, numerical values, recommendation direction, and core reasoning---was held constant while communication style varied across AI Financial Assistant (AI), Certified Financial Planner (Expert), and Online Community Forum (OC) advice. Displayed source attribution was independently manipulated through correctly labeled, unlabeled, and mislabeled conditions, allowing us to separate attribution effects from source-specific communication cues. Expert advice was rated more favorably than AI advice on 9 of 10 outcomes (|d|=0.20--0.47), and this advantage remained visible without source labels, where Expert advice outperformed AI advice on 8 of 10 outcomes (up to d=0.60). Correct labels added limited differentiation, whereas mislabeling increased ratings of AI advice for situational fit and overall quality (d=0.42 for each) and attenuated the Expert advantage in situational fit (d=-0.36). Descriptive analyses further showed that AI advice was most responsive to displayed attribution and, conversely, that advice-style differences were most visible under an AI label. These findings show that financial-advice evaluations are shaped jointly by displayed attribution and message-level communication cues. We position disclosure not as a neutral transparency mechanism, but as an interpretive frame whose accuracy and interaction with message cues can shape trust and reliance.
articles.titleCn: 人们如何评估AI式、专家式和同行式财务建议
articles.abstractCn: 随着生成式人工智能日益成为日常决策，包括财务选择中常见的来源，理解人们如何评价人工智能生成的财务建议至关重要。我们进行了一项预先注册的简短情景实验（N = 285），在实验中，实质性财务内容——包括事实、数值、建议方向和核心推理——保持不变，而沟通风格在人工智能财务助手（AI）、认证财务规划师（专家）和在线社区论坛（OC）建议中有所不同。通过正确标记、未标记和错误标记的条件独立操纵显示来源归属，使我们能够将归属效应与特定来源的沟通线索分开。在10个结果中的9个（|d|=0.20--0.47），专家建议的评分高于人工智能建议，并且这种优势在没有来源标签的情况下仍然可见，其中专家建议在10个结果中的8个（最高d=0.60）优于人工智能建议。正确标签仅增加了有限的不同，而错误标记提高了人工智能建议在情境适应性和整体质量上的评分（每个d=0.42），并减弱了专家在情境适应性上的优势（d=-0.36）。描述性分析进一步表明，人工智能建议对显示的归属最为敏感，反之，建议风格的差异在人工智能标签下最为明显。这些发现表明，财务建议的评价受到显示归属和消息级沟通线索的共同影响。我们将披露定位为一种解释性框架，而不是中性的透明机制，其准确性和与消息线索的相互作用可以塑造信任和依赖。

articles.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
articles.abstract: Retrieving relevant evidence from noisy web data is challenging, particularly in sensitive domains containing incomplete reports, heterogeneous language, and irrelevant content. We present Guardian Crawler, a reproducible retrieval-first testbed for controlled experiments on knowledge discovery and evidence-grounded summarization over synthetic web-like corpora. The architecture combines BM25 retrieval with risk-aware, embedding-augmented, and hybrid reranking, followed by constrained retrieval-augmented generation with explicit document citations. Experiments on a synthetic 900-document corpus and 10 queries produced the highest descriptive retrieval scores under risk-based reranking, with P@10 = 1.00 and NDCG@10 = 0.94, compared with 0.94 and 0.81 for BM25. The best hybrid and BM25+Semantic configurations reached NDCG@10 values of 0.94 and 0.88, respectively. All 41 evaluable generated bullets passed the lexical coverage threshold; an automated LLM judge classified 36 as supported, one as partially supported, and four as unsupported. These results demonstrate the feasibility of Guardian Crawler as a controlled testbed but do not establish statistical superiority, human-validated faithfulness, or transfer to live-web investigative environments.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a Short Paper at KDIR 2026 (International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Information Retrieval)
articles.titleCn: 守护者爬虫：基于有界LLM增强的检索优先知识发现，用于含噪声网络情报
articles.abstractCn: 从嘈杂的网页数据中检索相关证据是一项挑战，特别是在包含不完整报告、异构语言和不相关内容的敏感领域。我们提出了Guardian Crawler，一个可复现的以检索为先的测试平台，用于在合成类网页语料库上进行知识发现和基于证据的摘要的受控实验。该架构结合了BM25检索、风险感知、嵌入增强和混合重排序，随后进行约束检索增强生成，并附带明确的文档引用。在包含900份文档的合成语料库和10个查询的实验中，基于风险的重排序在描述性检索得分上表现最佳，P@10达到1.00，NDCG@10为0.94，而BM25的得分分别为0.94和0.81。最佳混合配置和BM25+语义配置的NDCG@10值分别为0.94和0.88。所有41个可评估生成的要点均通过了词汇覆盖率阈值；自动LLM裁判将其中36个归类为支持，1个为部分支持，4个为不支持。这些结果表明Guardian Crawler作为受控测试平台的可行性，但并未证明其在统计优越性、人工验证的忠实性或迁移到实际网络调查环境方面的能力。

articles.title: How Far Do Foundation Models Transfer to Infant Signals? A Cross-Dataset Transfer Audit with a Unified Need Ontology
articles.abstract: Public infant cry corpora are small, label-incompatible, and almost always evaluated one corpus at a time. We ask what this practice hides and what fixes it. Across four cry corpora screened by a multi-level leakage audit (byte-level and embedding-level deduplication plus a within-corpus train-test near-duplicate audit), we probe four frozen encoders and a handcrafted baseline under a unified five-class need ontology and shared task formulations. The audit exposes what single-corpus evaluation conceals: within-domain macro-F1 swings by 0.57-0.80 for the same encoder, cross-corpus transfer is negative on average (negative-transfer ratio 0.19-0.35, significant in 18 of 30 directed cells, BH-FDR), and 349 content-identical clip groups carry conflicting metadata labels across corpus distributions. The same audit, however, reveals a consistent way forward. Transfer into the noisiest corpus is consistently positive in effect size at matched training size and after near-duplicate removal, offering a practical recipe for small, noisy corpora. Frozen probes saturate at modest label budgets, while stabilized fine-tuning wins with full labels; domain-adaptive pretraining significantly beats stabilized fine-tuning at 5-10-shot (the 1-shot advantage is not robust to optimization-seed variance) but shows no significant advantage at 50-shot or beyond. In the tested binary, shared-label settings, ontology-mapped joint training wins in all four encoder-by-target combinations, whereas naively merging unmapped labels costs up to 37 F1 points. We release the ontology, mapping code, and audit pipeline, turning incompatible cry corpora into a usable joint-training resource.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Under review at AAAI 2027
articles.titleCn: 基础模型对婴儿信号迁移有多远？一项基于统一需求本体论的跨数据集迁移审计
articles.abstractCn: 公开的婴儿哭声语料库规模小、标签不兼容，并且几乎总是逐个语料库进行评估。我们探讨了这种做法隐藏了什么以及如何改进它。通过对四个经过多级泄漏审计筛选的哭声语料库（包括字节级和嵌入级去重，以及语料库内部训练-测试近乎重复审计）进行测试，我们在统一的五类需求本体和共享任务公式下，探究了四种冻结编码器和手工制作的基线模型。审计揭示了单语料库评估所掩盖的问题：同一编码器在领域内的宏观F1值波动范围为0.57-0.80，跨语料库迁移平均为负（负迁移率0.19-0.35，在30个有向单元中的18个中显著，采用BH-FDR校正），且有349组内容完全相同的片段组在跨语料库分布中携带冲突的元数据标签。然而，同样的审计也揭示了一种持续改进的路径。在匹配的训练规模下，迁移到噪声最大的语料库在去除近乎重复数据后始终具有正效应大小，为小型噪声语料库提供了一种实用解决方案。冻结探针在适度的标签预算下达到饱和，而稳定的微调在完整标签下胜出；领域自适应预训练在5-10次样本学习中显著优于稳定的微调（1次样本的优势对优化种子方差不稳健），但在50次样本学习或更多时没有显著优势。在测试的二元、共享标签设置中，本体映射联合训练在所有四种编码器-目标组合中都胜出，而盲目合并未映射标签会损失高达37个F1点。我们发布了本体、映射代码和审计流程，将不兼容的哭声语料库转化为可用的联合训练资源。

articles.title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review
articles.abstract: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices shape AI-review judgments when reported scientific content is preserved and how these effects vary across evaluation conditions. We construct a controlled corpus of 4,200 full-paper manuscripts derived from 120 anonymized ICLR 2026 submissions. Two LLM rewriters transform six rhetorical dimensions in opposing directions, and five LLM reviewers evaluate the resulting manuscripts under standard and strict protocols. We also test joint, recursive, and reviewer-guided rewriting. Our results show that rhetorical sensitivity is structured rather than uniform. Evidence framing and novelty stance produce the largest positive-negative contrasts in overall assessment, with scope framing forming a weaker second tier; the remaining dimensions have smaller or less stable effects. This hierarchy persists across human-assessed quality levels, but score movement depends strongly on the AI reviewer's original score: lower scores tend to rise, higher scores tend to fall, and directional contrasts are clearest in the middle ranges. More elaborate workflows do not reliably yield larger gains. Joint rewriting is strongly rewriter-dependent, reviewer guidance does not consistently outperform an unguided second pass, and repeated rewriting yields diminishing, configuration-dependent returns. Across conditions, the rewriter primarily determines the separation between opposing variants, whereas the reviewer determines the magnitude and sign of their score effects. Strict review lowers mean OA by 1.36 points without consistently changing rhetorical sensitivity. These findings identify when rhetorical presentation influences AI scientific review and motivate evaluation systems robust to content-preserving variation in scientific writing.
articles.titleCn: 如何通过修辞技巧“奖励”AI审稿人？解析基于AI的同行评审中的修辞敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地参与到科学评估中，我们研究了一种潜在的奖励黑客形式：当报告的科学内容被保留时，修辞选择如何影响AI评审判断，以及这些影响在不同评估条件下的变化。我们构建了一个包含4,200篇完整论文手稿的受控语料库，这些手稿来自120篇匿名化的ICLR 2026提交。两个LLM改写器在六个修辞维度上朝相反方向进行改写，五个LLM评审员在标准协议和严格协议下评估由此产生的手稿。我们还测试了联合改写、递归改写和评审员指导的改写。我们的结果表明，修辞敏感性具有结构性而非均匀性。证据框架和新颖性立场在整体评估中产生了最大的正负对比，范围框架形成较弱的第二层级；其余维度具有较小或不太稳定的影响。这种层级结构在人类评估的质量水平上持续存在，但分数变动强烈依赖于AI评审员的原始分数：低分倾向于上升，高分倾向于下降，方向性对比在中间范围最为清晰。更复杂的流程并不能可靠地带来更大的收益。联合改写强烈依赖于改写器，评审员指导并不始终优于无指导的第二遍改写，重复改写会产生递减且配置相关的回报。在不同条件下，改写器主要决定了相反变体之间的分离度，而评审员决定了其分数效应的大小和符号。严格评审将平均OA分数降低了1.36分，但并未始终改变修辞敏感性。这些发现指出了修辞呈现何时会影响AI科学评审，并推动了能够抵御科学写作中内容保留变化的稳健评估系统。
